2. 给出首个学习算法，用于仅给定格点哈密顿量热亚稳态（建模为自由能的“局部极小”）副本时，学习该哈密顿量的系数。
3. 此外，我们对近期关于热亚稳态的面积律 [BCV25] 给出一个改进，该结果在热力学极限下成立。
我们的学习算法是严格的、时间高效的，并在系统尺寸和精度上接近样本最优。在技术层面，我们的论证基于这些 Gibbs 采样算法的量子 Fisher 信息的新近似局域性和凸性性质。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出并分析“平稳性检验”框架，声称可据热态/热亚稳态样本学习格点哈密顿量的相互作用图与系数，并给出热亚稳态面积律的改进；其算法被描述为严格、时间高效且接近样本最优。所提供的结论节选主要回顾与 Ising/图模型学习、伪似然、量子 Gibbs 采样及亚稳态文献的关系，并列出未来方向，未给出超出上述主张的、经独立验证的最终结论；适用范围为所讨论的格点哈密顿量与热/亚稳态设定。
innovations: 提出“平稳性检验”学习框架，通过猜测哈密顿量并测量局部可观测量在细致平衡量子马尔可夫链下的变化率。
作者声称给出首个可在所有温度下从 Gibbs 态样本学习格点哈密顿量相互作用图（结构学习）的算法。
作者声称给出首个仅用热亚稳态样本学习格点哈密顿量系数的算法，并改进热亚稳态面积律。

title: Quantum synchronization in atom-cavity coupled systems
summary: We consider a cavity quantum electrodynamics (CQED) setup where an ensemble of spin-1 atoms driven by a classical field interacts with two driven cavity field modes. We show that the two sub-systems - the atoms and the two-mode cavity field, exhibit limit-cycle or quantum synchronization depending on the cavity drive strengths and other system parameters. In order to visualize the limit cycle and synchronization in the field, we introduce generalized two-mode field Husimi-Q function using SU(2) coherent states. For atomic spin states, we make use of spin-1 Husimi-Q function to visualize the same. We further corroborate the occurrence of field synchronization and limit cycle by analyzing $U(1)$ symmetry breaking, Wigner quasi-probability distribution, coherence properties of reduced field density matrix. Our results reveal intriguing interplay between the limit-cycle and quantum synchronization behavior, highlighting emergent quantum phenomena in driven dissipative interacting quantum systems. Additionally, we calculate Wehrl mutual information between the two modes and find that the field synchronization and Wehrl mutual information are mutually exclusive. Our study would be important to extract quantum advantages in quantum metrology using coupled atom-cavity systems.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个腔量子电动力学（CQED）装置，其中由经典场驱动的自旋-1原子系综与两个受驱腔场模式相互作用。我们表明，两个子系统——原子和双模腔场——会依据腔驱动强度及其他系统参数表现出极限环或量子同步。为了可视化场中的极限环与同步，我们利用SU(2)相干态引入广义双模场Husimi-Q函数。对于原子自旋态，我们使用自旋-1 Husimi-Q函数来可视化同样的现象。我们进一步通过分析$U(1)$对称性破缺、Wigner准概率分布、约化场密度矩阵的相干性质，来佐证场同步和极限环的发生。我们的结果揭示了极限环与量子同步行为之间有趣的相互作用，突出了受驱耗散相互作用量子系统中的涌现量子现象。此外，我们计算了两个模式之间的Wehrl互信息，并发现场同步与Wehrl互信息是互斥的。我们的研究对于利用耦合原子-腔系统在量子计量中提取量子优势将具有重要意义。
AI.conclusion: 作者在所考虑的驱动耗散原子-腔系统中报告了量子同步：有效自旋-1原子系综介导两个腔模相互作用，并在同一平台上于场和原子中识别出相位扩散的极限环态与相位局域的同步态。无腔驱动时系统形成有限占据但无确定相位的极限环；弱相等腔驱动下出现近$\phi=\pm\pi$的反相同步，并伴随约化密度矩阵的非对角相干。作者还指出同步现象来自多个总光子数扇区的集体相位结构，且场同步与Wehrl互信息互斥，因此同步不等同于模间关联增强；这些结论限于所研究参数范围。
innovations: 作者提出利用SU(2)相干态构造广义双模场Husimi-Q函数，以可视化场中的极限环与同步。
作者在同一驱动耗散原子-腔平台上识别出场与原子中的相位扩散极限环态和相位局域同步态。
作者报告场同步与两模间Wehrl互信息互斥，二者可作为不同诊断量。

title: Constant-Per-Layer-Depth MPS-Pretrained Ansatz for Noisy Distributed Quantum Processors
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures; Supplementary Information (22 pages) appended
summary: Distributed quantum processors could scale variational algorithms beyond single devices, but circuit depth, communication overhead, and noise limit their performance. We compare ladder, mixed-canonical, and brick-wall realizations of matrix-product-state (MPS) pretraining with matched per-layer two-qubit-block resources. Despite comparable ideal variational quantum eigensolver performance and gradient scales, the shallower brick-wall architecture reduces circuit duration, idle-time decoherence, and zero-noise-extrapolation (ZNE) overhead, yielding superior noisy and ZNE-assisted performance. We then extend MPS-pretrained circuits to modular processors with one communication qubit per quantum processing unit (QPU); a nearest-neighbor QPU-path schedule keeps the per-layer depth constant as QPUs are added. Distributed circuits whose inter-QPU links realize long-range interactions of the target Hamiltonian match or outperform the single-processor brick-wall under noise when communication idle time is short compared with the coherence time. These results establish hardware-aware co-design of tensor-network pretraining, circuit scheduling, and communication topology as a principle for variational quantum computation on noisy modular hardware.

AI.abstract_zh: 分布式量子处理器可将变分算法扩展到单设备之外，但电路深度、通信开销和噪声限制其性能。我们在每层两比特块资源匹配的条件下，比较矩阵乘积态（MPS）预训练的梯形（ladder）、混合规范（mixed-canonical）和砖墙（brick-wall）实现。尽管理想变分量子本征求解器（VQE）性能和梯度尺度相当，较浅的砖墙架构降低了电路持续时间、空闲时间退相干和零噪声外推（ZNE）开销，从而获得更优的含噪和ZNE辅助性能。随后我们将MPS预训练电路扩展到模块化处理器，每个量子处理单元（QPU）有一个通信量子比特；最近邻QPU路径调度使每层深度在增加QPU时保持恒定。当通信空闲时间相比相干时间较短时，其QPU间链路实现目标哈密顿量长程相互作用的分布式电路在噪声下达到或超过单处理器砖墙架构。这些结果确立了张量网络预训练、电路调度和通信拓扑的硬件感知协同设计，作为含噪模块化硬件上变分量子计算的原则。
AI.conclusion: 在基线两比特门持续时间下的组合门局域噪声模型中，三种单处理器布局里实现调度最浅的砖墙布局具有最低的未缓解误差，并在ZNE辅助训练后具有最低的无噪声能量误差；由于三种布局每层两比特块数相同，这一差异反映的是这些块的并行化与调度方式而非标称数量。分布式情形则体现通过QPU间链路获得的连通性增益与通信轮次中空闲时间退相干之间的权衡：在链路实现目标哈密顿量中链所缺失的耦合、且通信空闲时间相对相干时间较短时，分布式电路可在噪声下达到或超过单处理器砖墙；最近邻QPU路径调度可将砖墙的深度优势带到模块化处理器，使增加QPU不增加每层两比特块深度。ZNE不能消除架构相关的执行成本，含噪训练会缩小链路和全连接电路在预训练起点所持有的无噪声优势；分布式的收益应在目标器件噪声下训练后的电路上评判。上述比较使用八或九个量子比特、至多三个QPU，并采用不含测量散粒噪声的唯象噪声模型，向更大系统、其他噪声区制和目标哈密顿量的推广仍有待考察。
innovations: 在每层两比特块资源匹配下比较梯形、混合规范和砖墙MPS预训练实现，表明较浅砖墙调度可降低含噪执行与ZNE开销。
将MPS预训练电路扩展到每个QPU一个通信量子比特的模块化处理器，并用最近邻QPU路径调度保持每层深度恒定。
提出将张量网络预训练、电路调度和通信拓扑进行硬件感知协同设计的原则。

title: Dissipation-Sensitivity Trade-Off in Dissipative Bosonic Systems
summary: We discover a universal trade-off between the dissipation required to maintain a quantum state more sensitive than a thermal one and the sensitivity gain for a driven single-mode bosonic system under a thermal environment. Specifically, for Gaussian states, we rigorously derive a lower bound on the entropy production rate in the steady state in terms of the quantum Fisher information gain relative to a thermal reference state. Numerical investigations of Kerr nonlinearities further support that these bounds can hold beyond the Gaussian regime. Our results establish a new connection between steady-state thermodynamics and quantum metrological performance.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们发现在热环境下，对于驱动单模玻色系统，维持一个比热态更灵敏的量子态所需的耗散与灵敏度增益之间存在一种普适的权衡。具体而言，对于高斯态，我们严格推导出稳态下熵产生率的一个下界，该下界以相对于热参考态的量子 Fisher 信息增益来表示。对 Kerr 非线性的数值研究进一步支持这些下界可能在高斯区域之外也成立。我们的结果在稳态热力学与量子计量性能之间建立了一种新的联系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究在热环境下的驱动单模玻色系统中发现耗散与灵敏度增益之间的普适权衡，并针对高斯态严格给出以量子 Fisher 信息增益表示的稳态熵产生率下界；Kerr 非线性的数值研究支持这些下界可能在高斯区域之外成立。上述结论主要基于摘要所述的理论推导与数值证据，适用范围以所研究的驱动单模玻色系统和热环境为限。
innovations: 发现维持比热态更灵敏的量子态所需耗散与灵敏度增益之间的普适权衡。
对高斯态严格推导出稳态熵产生率的下界，并用相对于热参考态的量子 Fisher 信息增益表示。
通过 Kerr 非线性的数值研究支持该下界可能在高斯区域之外成立。

title: Multivariate Quantum Signal Processing
summary: We develop Multivariate Quantum Signal Processing for designing matrix-valued transformations of multiple noncommuting nonnormal block-encoded matrices. Our framework equips quantum transducers with the analytic structure of multiport Infinite-Impulse-Response (IIR) filters and establishes a transfer-function methodology for designing quantum query algorithms. Efficiently computable analytic bounds that hold uniformly across the oracle promise yield efficient quantum circuits with logarithmic error dependence and near-unity success probability, paralleling the approximation-theoretic guarantees of univariate QSP/QSVT. We provide a complete characterization of achievable transfer functions and a principled library of analytic IIR components. Our modular designs greatly improve or resolve the per-oracle query complexity of open multi-oracle problems: (1) Hamiltonian simulation under $H=\sum_j H_j$ with weighted quasinorm cost $\approx t\langle\vecλ,\vec C\rangle_{1/2}+\mathcal{O}(\|\vec C\|_1\log(1/ε))$ for block-encoding normalizations $\vecλ$ and costs $\vec C$; (2) sparse simulation with optimal time--norm $Θ(\sqrt{d}\|H\|_{\rm 1\to2}t)$ and additive error dependence; (3) solving linear systems and (4) differential equations under minimal matrix assumptions with optimal weighted state-preparation and multi-term cost; (5) ground-state preparation and energy estimation; (6) generalized eigenvalue problems. We apply these to exactly simulate downfolded Hamiltonians with leading cost $t\langle\vecλ_{\rm eff},\vec C_{\rm eff}\rangle_{1/2}$ further reduced by fractional dynamic correlation energy contributions from coarse-grained Hamiltonians, and show similar classical-data-input-reduction results for multiscale graph classification via Kron reduction. We also show the online generalization with anisotropic Kalman filtering of streaming quantum data.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们发展多元量子信号处理，用于设计多个非对易、非正规块编码矩阵的矩阵值变换。我们的框架为量子换能器赋予多端口无限脉冲响应（IIR）滤波器的解析结构，并建立用于设计量子查询算法的传递函数方法。在 oracle 承诺上一致成立且可高效计算的解析界，产生具有对数误差依赖和接近 1 成功概率的高效量子电路，与单变量 QSP/QSVT 的近似理论保证相平行。我们给出可实现传递函数的完整刻画以及一个有原则的解析 IIR 组件库。我们的模块化设计大幅改进或解决了开放多 oracle 问题的逐 oracle 查询复杂度：（1）在 $H=\sum_j H_j$ 下的哈密顿量模拟，对于块编码归一化 $\vecλ$ 和成本 $\vec C$，加权拟范数成本约为 $t\langle\vecλ,\vec C\rangle_{1/2}+\mathcal{O}(\|\vec C\|_1\log(1/ε))$；（2）稀疏模拟，具有最优时间—范数 $Θ(\sqrt{d}\|H\|_{\rm 1\to2}t)$ 和加性误差依赖；（3）求解线性系统，以及（4）在最小矩阵假设下求解微分方程，具有最优加权态制备与多项成本；（5）基态制备与能量估计；（6）广义特征值问题。我们将这些应用于精确模拟下折叠哈密顿量，其主导成本为 $t\langle\vecλ_{\rm eff},\vec C_{\rm eff}\rangle_{1/2}$，并进一步被来自粗粒化哈密顿量的分数动态关联能贡献降低；并展示通过 Kron 约化进行多尺度图分类的类似经典数据输入缩减结果。我们还展示了对流式量子数据进行各向异性卡尔曼滤波的在线推广。
AI.conclusion: 摘要报告：多元量子信号处理为多个非对易、非正规块编码矩阵的矩阵值变换提供了设计框架，并建立了用于量子查询算法的传递函数方法；其解析界可产生具有对数误差依赖和接近 1 成功概率的高效量子电路。该框架被用于改进或解决若干多 oracle 问题的逐 oracle 查询复杂度，并展示了下折叠哈密顿量模拟、Kron 约化多尺度图分类及流式量子数据各向异性卡尔曼滤波等应用。由于未提供正文结论章节，以上结论仅依据原始摘要，未包含独立验证或更广适用范围。
innovations: 提出多元量子信号处理框架，用于设计多个非对易、非正规块编码矩阵的矩阵值变换。
将量子换能器与多端口 IIR 滤波器的解析结构联系起来，建立用于设计量子查询算法的传递函数方法。
给出可实现传递函数的完整刻画和解析 IIR 组件库，并在多个多 oracle 问题上改进或解决逐 oracle 查询复杂度。

title: Classical Hardness of Learning Functions of Hamiltonians
summary: Morohoshi, Nakayama, Manabe, and Mitarai proposed a physically motivated quantum machine learning problem in which the goal is to predict quantities of the form $\operatorname{Tr}[f(H)ρ]$ from classical descriptions of a Hamiltonian $H$ and a quantum state $ρ$, where $f$ is an unknown function. We call this problem Hamiltonian function learning in this paper. They constructed an efficient quantum learning algorithm under suitable conditions, while leaving a rigorous proof of average-case classical hardness open. In this paper, we rigorously prove the average-case classical hardness for two distribution-specific Hamiltonian function learning problems for $f_{\cos,π}(λ)=\cos(πλ)$ and $f_{\exp,β}(λ)=e^{-βλ}$ discussed in the paper of Morohoshi et al. under the assumption of the average-case hardness of factoring random RSA moduli. More specifically, we show that an efficient classical randomized learner under squared loss whose output hypotheses are evaluable in classical polynomial time for either problem would yield a classical randomized polynomial-time algorithm for factoring random RSA moduli.

AI.abstract_zh: Morohoshi、Nakayama、Manabe 和 Mitarai 提出了一个具有物理动机的量子机器学习问题，其目标是根据哈密顿量 $H$ 和量子态 $\rho$ 的经典描述，预测形如 $\operatorname{Tr}[f(H)\rho]$ 的量，其中 $f$ 是未知函数。本文将这一问题称为哈密顿量函数学习。他们在适当条件下构造了一种高效量子学习算法，但尚未给出平均情形经典困难性的严格证明。在本文中，我们严格证明了 Morohoshi 等人论文中讨论的两个分布特定的哈密顿量函数学习问题的平均情形经典困难性，分别对应 $f_{\cos,\pi}(\lambda)=\cos(\pi\lambda)$ 和 $f_{\exp,\beta}(\lambda)=e^{-\beta\lambda}$，其假设是分解随机 RSA 模数的平均情形困难性。更具体地说，我们证明：对于这两个问题中的任一问题，若存在一个在平方损失下高效、且其输出假设可在经典多项式时间内求值的经典随机学习器，则可得到一个用于分解随机 RSA 模数的经典随机多项式时间算法。
AI.conclusion: 在分解随机 RSA 模数的平均情形困难性假设下，作者证明了两类分布特定的哈密顿量函数学习问题（对应 $f_{\cos,\pi}$ 和 $f_{\exp,\beta}$）具有平均情形经典困难性：若存在平方损失下高效且输出假设可在经典多项式时间内求值的经典随机学习器，则可构造分解随机 RSA 模数的经典随机多项式时间算法。该结论适用于摘要所述的两个具体问题及相应假设；未提供正文结论章节。
innovations: 针对 Morohoshi 等人提出的哈密顿量函数学习问题，给出了两个分布特定问题的平均情形经典困难性的严格证明。
证明该困难性可归约到分解随机 RSA 模数的平均情形困难性：高效经典随机学习器将蕴含分解随机 RSA 模数的经典随机多项式时间算法。

title: Robustness hierarchy of bipartite quantum correlations under noisy dynamics
summary: Quantum correlations are fragile under noise, motivating quantitative measures that track not only their presence but also their degradation during physical evolution. We develop a robustness framework for the hierarchy of Bell nonlocality, EPR steering, and entanglement, establishing an ordering of the corresponding robustness measures and relating robustness to noise-induced transition times. We further formulate the instantaneous robustness decay along Lindblad dynamics as a directional derivative determined by both the evolution and the robustness functional. Applications to isotropic depolarizing noise and amplitude damping illustrate, respectively, the resulting resource transition times and the directional dependence of steering robustness. The framework provides an approach to characterizing the degradation and lifetime of bipartite quantum correlations under noisy dynamics.

AI.abstract_zh: 量子关联在噪声下很脆弱，这促使人们提出定量度量，不仅追踪其是否存在，也追踪其在物理演化过程中的退化。我们为贝尔非定域性、EPR导引和纠缠的层级发展了一个鲁棒性框架，建立相应鲁棒性度量的排序，并将鲁棒性与噪声诱导的转变时间联系起来。我们进一步将沿Lindblad动力学的瞬时鲁棒性衰减表述为由演化和鲁棒性泛函共同决定的方向导数。对各向同性退极化噪声和振幅阻尼的应用分别说明了所得的资源转变时间以及导引鲁棒性的方向依赖性。该框架提供了一种刻画噪声动力学下二分量子关联退化和寿命的方法。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出基于凸鲁棒性度量的动力学框架，将鲁棒性视为随物理量子轨迹演化的量，并把状态鲁棒性与支配其演化的Lindblad生成元直接联系，用以描述瞬时鲁棒性衰减和资源转变时间。该框架在两种互补噪声过程中得到展示：各向同性退极化动力学通过Werner族提供可解析基准，局域振幅阻尼展示向非对称、非幺正轨迹的扩展，并表明导引的方向性导致不同可信子系统的鲁棒性剖面和转变时间不同。适用范围为二分量子关联在Lindblad等开放系统噪声下的退化与寿命刻画；对更一般优化定义的资源度量、不可微点、时间依赖/非马尔可夫动力学、相关噪声及高维系统的扩展属于未来工作。
innovations: 建立贝尔非定域性、EPR导引和纠缠层级对应的鲁棒性度量框架，并给出相应鲁棒性度量的排序及其与噪声诱导转变时间的关系。
将沿Lindblad动力学的瞬时鲁棒性衰减表述为由演化和鲁棒性泛函共同决定的方向导数。
通过各向同性退极化噪声和振幅阻尼示例，分别说明资源转变时间以及导引鲁棒性的方向依赖性。

title: Vector chiral order and dynamical quantum phase transitions in an Ising chain with dimerized anisotropic Gamma interaction
summary: We investigate a transverse-field Ising chain with dimerized anisotropic Gamma interactions and demonstrate that, both in the absence and presence of Ising interactions, the competition between Gamma anisotropy and the transverse field gives rise to vector chiral order and dynamical quantum phase transitions. The phase diagram comprises positive and negative vector chiral phases and a paramagnetic phase, characterized by the vector spin chirality and the vector chiral order parameter. In the absence of Ising interactions, we identify a gapless critical line that exhibits no finite-size drift, along which the spin-spin correlations and subsystem entanglement entropy display behavior distinct from that of Ising criticality. Furthermore, we find that the critical times of dynamical quantum phase transitions form periodic or aperiodic sequences, depending on the quench path. Our findings highlight how dimerized off-diagonal exchange enriches both equilibrium ordering and dynamical critical behavior in a quantum Ising chain.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有二聚化各向异性Γ相互作用的横场Ising链，并证明，在不存在和存在Ising相互作用两种情况下，Γ各向异性与横场之间的竞争都会产生矢量手性序和动力学量子相变。相图包含正、负矢量手性相以及一个顺磁相，并由矢量自旋手性和矢量手性序参量刻画。在不存在Ising相互作用时，我们识别出一条无能隙临界线，该临界线不表现出有限尺寸漂移；沿此临界线，自旋-自旋关联和子系统纠缠熵表现出不同于Ising临界性的行为。此外，我们发现动力学量子相变的临界时间形成周期或非周期序列，具体取决于淬火路径。我们的发现凸显了二聚化非对角交换如何丰富量子Ising链中的平衡序和动力学临界行为。
AI.conclusion: 作者总结认为，在该二聚化各向异性Γ相互作用的横场Ising链中，Γ各向异性与横场的竞争在有无Ising相互作用时均塑造平衡序与非平衡临界性；自旋-自旋关联和矢量手性序参量可区分正、负矢量手性相与顺磁相。无Ising相互作用时，作者识别出一条未观察到有限尺寸漂移的无能隙临界线，其自旋关联和子系统纠缠熵不同于Ising临界性；淬火路径决定动力学量子相变临界时间呈周期或非周期序列。上述结论限于该理论模型及所考察的淬火情形，尚非独立实验验证。
innovations: 研究具有二聚化各向异性Γ相互作用的横场Ising链，指出Γ各向异性与横场竞争可产生矢量手性序和动力学量子相变。
在无Ising相互作用时识别出无有限尺寸漂移的无能隙临界线，并指出其自旋关联与子系统纠缠熵行为不同于Ising临界性。
发现动力学量子相变临界时间随淬火路径呈周期或非周期序列。

title: Rapid mixing of quantum spin chains at any finite temperature
summary: We prove that a quasi-local quantum Gibbs sampler rapidly mixes to the Gibbs state of any 1D finite-range Hamiltonian at all finite temperatures in $\mathcal{O}\left(\log (n/\varepsilon)\right)$ time. Each update traces out a contiguous block of constant length and reconstructs it using the Petz recovery map, following early proposals for quantum heat-bath Gibbs samplers by Kastoryano and Brandão~\cite{kastoryano2016quantum}. Our proof directly bounds the distance between the updated state and the target Gibbs state using quantum Wasserstein distance of order $1$. We further provide $\mathcal{O}(\text{polylog}(n/\varepsilon))$ depth of quantum circuits to prepare these Gibbs states. We hope these techniques will facilitate the analysis and design of other Gibbs samplers.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们证明，一个准局域量子 Gibbs 采样器可在 $\mathcal{O}\left(\log (n/\varepsilon)\right)$ 时间内快速混合到任意一维有限程哈密顿量在所有有限温度下的 Gibbs 态。每次更新会迹除一个常数长度的连续块，并使用 Petz 恢复映射重构它，这遵循 Kastoryano 和 Brandão 早期关于量子热浴 Gibbs 采样器的提议~\cite{kastoryano2016quantum}。我们的证明使用一阶量子 Wasserstein 距离直接界定更新后状态与目标 Gibbs 态之间的距离。我们进一步提供 $\mathcal{O}(\text{polylog}(n/\varepsilon))$ 深度的量子电路来制备这些 Gibbs 态。我们希望这些技术将有助于其他 Gibbs 采样器的分析和设计。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出基于 Petz 恢复的量子块热浴动力学，并证明对所考虑的一维自旋链在每个固定有限温度下都能快速混合，且不依赖任何对易性假设；证明通过两个一维 Gibbs 态的静态局域性质，直接在一阶量子 $W_1$ 距离中建立收缩，并给出制备相应 Gibbs 态的低深度量子电路。该结论适用于所考虑的一维有限程自旋链，作者将 $\beta$ 和 $d$ 视为固定参数，并指出当前实现的门开销至少随 $\beta$ 呈三重指数增长，低温效率仍待更精细界澄清。
innovations: 作者提出基于 Petz 恢复的量子块热浴动力学，并在不假设对易性的情况下证明一维自旋链的快速混合。
作者利用一维 Gibbs 态的两个静态局域性质，直接在一阶量子 $W_1$ 距离中建立收缩界。
作者给出制备相应 Gibbs 态的低深度量子电路。

title: Fermionic Gaussian Scrooge Ensembles in Deep Thermalization
summary: Measuring part of a many-body wave function generates a projected ensemble of pure quantum states on the unmeasured subsystem. Recent advances in deep thermalization have shown that, in chaotic systems, this ensemble universally converges to the maximally random ensemble compatible with its average density matrix, known as the Scrooge ensemble. By contrast, free-fermion systems are nonchaotic, and their quantum states are constrained to remain Gaussian. Motivated by this distinction, we introduce the fermionic Gaussian Scrooge ensemble to describe deep thermalization in generic free-fermion systems. This ensemble is defined as a distortion of the Gaussian Haar ensemble by the average density matrix, and its moments reveal an enlarged symmetry of Gaussian states in the replicated Hilbert space. We demonstrate the emergence of the fermionic Gaussian Scrooge ensemble in two complementary settings: (1) we analytically prove that the projected ensemble of the SYK$_2$ model follows the fermionic Gaussian Scrooge ensemble at arbitrary evolution times; (2) we provide numerical evidence that it emerges at sufficiently long times in random Gaussian circuits with charge conservation. Our results establish the fermionic Gaussian Scrooge ensemble as a universal description of deep thermalization in free-fermion systems.

AI.abstract_zh: 测量多体波函数的一部分会在未测量子系统上生成纯量子态的投影系综。深度热化的近期进展表明，在混沌系统中，该系综普遍收敛到与其平均密度矩阵相容的最大随机系综，即 Scrooge 系综。相比之下，自由费米子系统是非混沌的，其量子态被约束为保持高斯性。受这一区别启发，我们引入费米子高斯 Scrooge 系综，以描述一般自由费米子系统中的深度热化。该系综定义为高斯 Haar 系综受平均密度矩阵扭曲后的结果，其矩揭示了复制希尔伯特空间中高斯态的一个扩展对称性。我们在两个互补情形中展示了费米子高斯 Scrooge 系综的出现：(1) 我们解析证明 SYK$_2$ 模型的投影系综在任意演化时刻都遵循费米子高斯 Scrooge 系综；(2) 我们提供数值证据表明，在具有电荷守恒的随机高斯电路中，该系综在足够长的时间出现。我们的结果确立了费米子高斯 Scrooge 系综作为自由费米子系统中深度热化的普适描述。
AI.conclusion: 摘要提出，费米子高斯 Scrooge 系综可作为自由费米子系统中深度热化的普适描述；支持来自 SYK$_2$ 模型的解析结果以及具有电荷守恒的随机高斯电路的数值证据。该结论的适用范围为摘要所述的一般自由费米子系统；未提供正文结论章节，且不应视为已独立验证。
innovations: 引入费米子高斯 Scrooge 系综，将其定义为高斯 Haar 系综受平均密度矩阵扭曲后的结果，用于描述一般自由费米子系统中的深度热化。
指出该系综的矩揭示复制希尔伯特空间中高斯态的扩展对称性。
解析证明 SYK$_2$ 模型的投影系综在任意演化时刻遵循该系综，并给出具有电荷守恒的随机高斯电路中的数值证据。

title: Experimental quantification of quantum coherence for a set of quantum states
summary: We present a direct experimental verification of quantum coherence for a set of quantum states in a basis-independent manner. We find that the theory of quantum coherence for a set of quantum states matches our experimental results perfectly and can be applied to protocols like BB84 and quantum secure direct communication. Using a Sagnac interferometer, we experimentally quantify the quantum coherence for two sets of experimental states. Moreover, we introduce a novel application of set coherence, illustrating that the states employed in the BB84 protocol exhibit maximal set coherence. Our results pave the way for wider applications of quantum coherence for a set of quantum states, including quantum key distribution protocols and probabilistic quantum cloning.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们以与基无关的方式，对一组量子态的量子相干性进行了直接的实验验证。我们发现，针对一组量子态的量子相干性理论与我们的实验结果完全吻合，并且可应用于BB84和量子安全直接通信等协议。利用Sagnac干涉仪，我们实验量化了两组实验态的量子相干性。此外，我们引入了集合相干性的一种新应用，说明BB84协议中所使用的态具有最大的集合相干性。我们的结果为集合相干性更广泛的应用铺平了道路，包括量子密钥分发协议和概率量子克隆。
AI.conclusion: 利用Sagnac干涉仪，作者对两组量子态的基无关集合相干性进行了实验研究，实验值与理论值一致；在n=3情形下，由于波片旋转精度的限制，对与制备态|φ3⟩和|φ5⟩对应的角度α2作了近似，但最终实验结果仍与理论预测吻合。该结果支持集合相干性理论及其在BB84等协议中的适用性讨论，但所提供的材料未表明已独立验证量子密钥分发或量子克隆应用。
innovations: 以与基无关的方式对一组量子态的量子相干性进行了直接的实验验证。
利用Sagnac干涉仪实验量化了两组量子态的集合相干性。
提出集合相干性的新应用，说明BB84协议所用态具有最大集合相干性。

title: Linear-Time Encodable Quantum Codes near the CSS GV Bound
summary: We construct quantum CSS codes with rate-distance tradeoff approaching the CSS GV bound, which can be encoded by a quantum circuit of logarithmic depth and a linear number of gates. Our construction is heavily inspired by a work of Brehm and Resch and can be viewed as a quantum analogue of classical repeat multiple accumulate codes. The encoder has a particularly simple structure, consisting of a single constant depth outer quantum circuit followed by several classical accumulation and inverse-accumulation layers.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们构造了速率-距离权衡接近 CSS GV 界的量子 CSS 码，这些码可由对数深度且门数量为线性的量子电路编码。我们的构造深受 Brehm 和 Resch 工作的启发，可视为经典重复多次累加码的量子类比。编码器具有特别简单的结构，由单个常数深度外层量子电路后接若干经典累加层和逆累加层组成。
AI.conclusion: 摘要称该工作构造了速率-距离权衡接近 CSS GV 界的量子 CSS 码，并可由对数深度、线性门数量的量子电路编码；编码器结构简单。由于未提供正文结论章节，结论仅依据摘要陈述，相关性能与优势尚未在现有材料中独立验证。
innovations: 提出速率-距离权衡接近 CSS GV 界且可由对数深度、线性门数量电路编码的量子 CSS 码构造。
将所构造的码视为经典重复多次累加码的量子类比。
编码器由单个常数深度外层量子电路后接若干经典累加与逆累加层组成，结构简单。

title: Preservability of Measurement Incompatibility: Purification, Activation, and a No-Go Theorem
summary: Measurement incompatibility is a fundamental quantum resource that enables advantages in many quantum information tasks, including cryptography and communication. However, unavoidable interactions between a system and its environment can degrade or even completely destroy measurement incompatibility; such a process is referred to as a measurement-incompatibility-annihilating channel. Recently, the capability of noisy quantum dynamics to preserve measurement incompatibility has been characterized within the resource theory of measurement incompatibility preservability. This motivates studying how to purify the preservation of measurement incompatibility and how to activate it from a measurement-incompatibility-annihilating channel. To this end, we first introduce our figures of merit as robustness-based resource monotones within this resource theory. We demonstrate that while pre-filtering operations can strengthen measurement incompatibility preservability, they cannot activate it from an incompatibility-annihilating channel, establishing a no-go theorem. Furthermore, we explicitly demonstrate that an incompatibility-annihilating channel can be stochastically activated via post-filtering operations. Our results provide a practical framework for exploiting measurement incompatibility in quantum information processing.

AI.abstract_zh: 测量不相容性是一种基本量子资源，它使许多量子信息任务（包括密码学和通信）能够获得优势。然而，系统与其环境之间不可避免的相互作用会削弱甚至完全破坏测量不相容性；这种过程被称为测量不相容性湮灭信道。最近，含噪量子动力学保持测量不相容性的能力已在测量不相容性可保持性的资源理论中得到刻画。这促使我们研究如何纯化测量不相容性的保持，以及如何从测量不相容性湮灭信道中激活它。为此，我们首先在该资源理论中引入基于鲁棒性的资源单调量作为我们的品质因数。我们证明，虽然前滤波操作可以增强测量不相容性可保持性，但它们不能从不相容性湮灭信道中激活它，从而建立了一个不可行定理。此外，我们明确证明，不相容性湮灭信道可以通过后滤波操作被随机激活。我们的结果为在量子信息处理中利用测量不相容性提供了一个实用框架。
AI.conclusion: 在测量不相容性可保持性的资源理论下，作者引入可计算的单调量 \mathcal{R}^{\text{JM}}_{\text{IP}}，并在薛定谔图像中建立等价的基于导引的单调量 \mathcal{R}^{\text{LHS}}_{\text{IP}}；据此证明强不可行定理：仅靠前滤波操作无法对不相容性湮灭（IA）信道实现操作性的激活。数值结果表明，通过后滤波操作可以实现 IA 激活；结合前滤波和后滤波，还可在同一实验中实现 IA 信道的激活与蒸馏。上述结论限于该资源理论框架及所考虑的滤波方案，后滤波激活为数值证据，未涉及实验验证。
innovations: 在测量不相容性可保持性资源理论中引入可计算的单调量 \mathcal{R}^{\text{JM}}_{\text{IP}}，以替代原式 (1) 中不可计算的鲁棒性定义。
在薛定谔图像中建立等价的基于导引的单调量 \mathcal{R}^{\text{LHS}}_{\text{IP}}，以克服海森堡图像中滤波后完整 POVM 不可行的问题。
证明仅用前滤波不能从不相容性湮灭信道操作性激活测量不相容性的强不可行定理，并数值展示后滤波可实现随机激活及与前滤波结合实现激活和蒸馏。

title: Achieving Identical Stored Energy in Cascaded Collisional Quantum Battery Charging: Analytical Result
summary: Charging uniformity across distinct trials is an essential requirement for reliable quantum batteries. Nevertheless, intrinsic quantum stochasticity poses a fundamental challenge to this goal. This work investigates a two-qubit quantum battery within the framework of cascaded collision models. We propose an adaptive measurement on the charger after each collision, yielding two conditional battery states of equal expected stored energy. For chargers prepared in the excited state, we analytically prove that complete suppression of trajectory-dependent stored-energy fluctuations is attainable; for chargers prepared in general superposition states, our theory reveals that full suppression is fundamentally prohibited owing to battery-phase-dependent recursive dynamics. Numerical simulations are in excellent quantitative agreement with theoretical predictions. These findings provide a feasible pathway toward high-uniformity quantum-battery charging.

AI.abstract_zh: 在不同试验之间实现充电均匀性是可靠量子电池的一项基本要求。然而，内在的量子随机性对这一目标构成了根本性挑战。本文在级联碰撞模型框架下研究了一个两量子比特量子电池。我们提出在每次碰撞后对充电器进行自适应测量，从而得到两个具有相同期望存储能量的条件电池态。对于制备在激发态的充电器，我们通过解析证明可以完全抑制轨迹依赖的存储能量涨落；对于制备在一般叠加态的充电器，我们的理论揭示，由于电池相位依赖的递归动力学，完全抑制在根本上是被禁止的。数值模拟与理论预测在定量上高度一致。这些发现为通向高均匀性量子电池充电提供了一条可行途径。
AI.conclusion: 在级联碰撞模型框架下，作者提出通过对每次碰撞后的充电器进行自适应测量，可获得两个具有相同期望存储能量的条件电池态；并指出对于激发态充电器可完全抑制轨迹依赖的存储能量涨落，而对于一般叠加态充电器，由于电池相位依赖的递归动力学，完全抑制在根本上不可实现。摘要报告数值模拟与理论预测定量高度一致，作者据此认为这些结果为高均匀性量子电池充电提供了可行途径；上述结论为作者基于其模型与摘要所述分析提出的主张。
innovations: 提出在每次碰撞后对充电器进行自适应测量，从而得到两个具有相同期望存储能量的条件电池态。
针对激发态充电器，解析证明可完全抑制轨迹依赖的存储能量涨落。
针对一般叠加态充电器，理论揭示由于电池相位依赖的递归动力学，完全抑制在根本上不可实现。

title: Vacuum entanglement in a time-dependent electric field
summary: We analyze the correlations of the vacuum state of a charged scalar field by constructing localized observables in two disjoint regions. We consider a time-dependent homogeneous electric field and examine the time evolution of correlations by relating it with the particle-antiparticle creation through the Schwinger effect. Our results show that the electric field increases the mixedness of the states and enhances total correlations, while the distillable entanglement among the regions decreases, vanishing at a finite time for sufficiently intense pulses within the non-perturbative pair-production regime. We also discuss the effect of anisotropy induced by the external background, showing that the distribution of correlations acquires a nontrivial directional dependence.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们通过在两个互不相交的区域中构造局域可观测量，分析了带电标量场真空态的关联。我们考虑一个含时均匀电场，并通过将其与Schwinger效应中的粒子-反粒子产生相联系来考察关联的时间演化。我们的结果表明，电场会增加态的混合度并增强总关联，而区域间的可蒸馏纠缠会减少；在非微扰对产生区域内，对于足够强的脉冲，这种纠缠会在有限时间消失。我们还讨论了外部背景诱导的各向异性效应，表明关联分布会获得非平凡的方向依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 在所提供的材料中，作者在(1+1)和(1+3)维的均匀含时电场下研究了带电标量场真空态中经典与量子关联的分布，并采用Sauter型电脉冲。结果显示，电场提高区域熵和混合度，互信息通常也增长；强脉冲下变化更显著，反映超过$qE_{0}\Gamma^{2}>1/2$阈值时高效Schwinger对产生开始起作用。对数负度在强脉冲下下降更快，并在非微扰区足够强脉冲下于有限时间消失，表现为与纠缠突然死亡一致的行为；渐近未来呈现主要由$qE_{0}\Gamma^{2}$控制的阈值式行为。在(1+3)维中，互信息依赖局域区域连线与电场方向的相对取向，最大值出现在二者正交时。作者指出，对该潜在相变及其完整参数空间的详细刻画留待未来工作。
innovations: 构建有限个局域高斯可观测量：在两个相邻球对称空间区域内对场算符做涂抹，从而把量子信息方法应用于量子场论框架。
将含时均匀电场下真空关联的演化与Schwinger效应中的粒子-反粒子产生联系起来，并在(1+1)和(1+3)维中分析Sauter型脉冲下的关联分布。
在(1+3)维中分析外部背景诱导的各向异性，表明关联分布依赖局域区域连线与电场方向的相对取向。

title: Optimal initial states for quantum Fisher information in linearized cavity optomechanics
summary: We find the optimal initial states of a linearized cavity-optomechanical system for estimating the single-photon coupling by quantum Fisher information. In the red-detuned (beam-splitter) regime the interaction exchanges excitations between the two modes, and for pure inputs the Fisher information is four times the variance of the excitation-exchange operator, reducing the optimization to variance maximization with a closed-form solution. With the mechanical mode in a Fock state the probe is degenerate: any state saturating the photon-number constraint is optimal, and a Fock reference with many phonons enhances the per-photon sensitivity linearly. For an arbitrary fixed mechanical reference it becomes a phase-matched squeezed vacuum, from an exact bound on that coherence obtained by a Lagrange-dual argument. Jointly optimizing both modes at fixed total excitation number, the quantum Fisher information obeys a Heisenberg bound quadratic in the energy, saturated by equal superpositions of the two extremal eigenstates of the generator, equivalently a two-mode NOON state after a balanced beam splitter; balanced product Fock states reach only a linear enhancement. Exact diagonalization in truncated Fock spaces confirms all the results, the familiar single-photon input being the simplest saturating case. Three extensions are worked out: the blue sideband has an unbounded two-mode-squeezing spectrum, so the entangled optimum becomes impossible and the balanced product Fock state is exactly optimal at definite energy; under cavity loss the information accumulation turns linear on the cavity-lifetime timescale, at a renewal-optimal duration of about two and a half lifetimes; and for a state-of-the-art quantum-coherent coupling experiment the per-hour relative precision lies between one part in a million and ten parts in a million, number and thermal references being the most robust.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们利用量子 Fisher 信息，寻找线性化腔光力系统中用于估计单光子耦合的最优初始态。在红失谐（束分裂器）区，相互作用在两个模式之间交换激发；对于纯输入，Fisher 信息等于激发交换算符方差的四倍，从而将优化问题化为方差最大化，并具有闭式解。当机械模式处于 Fock 态时，探针是简并的：任何满足光子数约束的态都是最优的，而具有多声子的 Fock 参考会线性提高每光子灵敏度。对于任意固定的机械参考，最优态变为相位匹配的压缩真空；该结论来自通过 Lagrange 对偶论证得到的关于该相干性的精确界。在固定总激发数下联合优化两个模式时，量子 Fisher 信息服从能量二次型的 Heisenberg 界，并由生成元两个极端本征态的等权叠加饱和；经过平衡束分裂器后，这等价于双模 NOON 态；平衡乘积 Fock 态只能达到线性增强。截断 Fock 空间中的精确对角化证实了所有结果，常见的单光子输入是最简单的饱和情形。我们进一步给出三项扩展：蓝边带具有无界的两模压缩谱，因此纠缠最优态变得不可能，而在确定能量下平衡乘积 Fock 态恰好最优；在腔损耗下，信息积累在腔寿命时间尺度上转为线性，其更新最优持续时间约为 2.5 个寿命；对于最先进的量子相干耦合实验，每小时相对精度介于百万分之一到百万分之十之间，其中数态参考和热参考最为鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 作者报告：在线性化束分裂器（红失谐）区、纯输入条件下，可用闭式确定估计单光子光力耦合 g₀ 的最优初始态，核心是最大化激发交换算符在初始态上的方差；结果包括固定一个模式时的简并最优性、相位匹配压缩真空最优性，以及两模式自由时由束分裂器变换的 NOON 态饱和能量二次型 Heisenberg 界，并均由截断 Fock 空间精确对角化数值验证。蓝边带、腔损耗和 Verhagen 等实验参数下的扩展给出各自适用范围；其中每小时相对精度 10⁻⁶–10⁻⁵ 与数态/热参考更鲁棒的判断属于参数化案例研究。
innovations: 给出线性化束分裂器区估计单光子光力耦合 g₀ 的最优初始态闭式解，并证明优化等价于激发交换算符方差最大化。
通过固定平均占据下双光子相干性的新矩界，得到任意固定机械参考时相位匹配压缩真空的精确最优性。
推导蓝边带、腔损耗和实验参数下的扩展结果，包括蓝边带平衡乘积 Fock 态的精确最优性及损耗下的通用 QFI 曲线。

title: Robust and leakage-resilient device-independent oblivious transfer in MiniQCryp
summary:
Assuming post-quantum one-way functions, we construct device-independent (DI) oblivious transfer (OT) and bit commitment: honest parties use only trusted classical computation to operate untrusted quantum devices, which may share arbitrary entanglement and behave non-IID. Security is simulation-based against quantum polynomial-time adversaries and composes sequentially with efficient simulators. One protocol skeleton serves both, in two regimes. With isolated laboratories and coordinate-local measurements in the honest receiver's device, it tolerates a constant rate of honest-device faults. With polylogarithmically many qubits of adaptive leakage between the laboratories and arbitrary joint measurements, it tolerates an inverse-polylogarithmic rate. Each elementary DI call uses a fresh, isolated batch of polylogarithmically many device coordinates, and total device use in the compiled OT protocol is polynomial. The commitment has efficient simulators against both parties and yields DI coin tossing with abort.
  Because OT is complete for secure computation, the construction yields a DI protocol, with abort, for every efficiently computable classical functionality on a fixed number of parties, secure against static corruption of any proper subset of them.
  The commitment's extractor changes a public parity relation through classical equivocation and leaves the device execution, hence its leakage, unchanged. A commit-and-prove functionality, disjoint audits, and an affine consistency check link the certified correlations to ideal OT. Sender security rests on a selector-aware parallel-repetition bound for the Magic Square game, which we derive from the two-round threshold theorem of Kundu and Tan.

AI.abstract_zh:
在后量子单向函数假设下，我们构造设备无关（DI）不经意传输（OT）和比特承诺：诚实方仅使用可信经典计算来操作不可信量子设备，这些设备可以共享任意纠缠并表现为非独立同分布（non-IID）。安全性是基于模拟的，针对量子多项式时间敌手，并与高效模拟器顺序组合。一个协议骨架在两种情形下同时服务于二者。在隔离实验室以及诚实接收方设备中的坐标局域测量下，它容忍常数率的诚实设备故障。在实验室之间具有多对数数量子比特的自适应泄漏以及任意联合测量时，它容忍逆多对数率。每次基本 DI 调用使用一批全新的、隔离的多对数数量设备坐标，并且编译后的 OT 协议中总设备使用量为多项式。该承诺对双方均具有高效模拟器，并产生带中止的 DI 抛币。
由于 OT 对于安全计算是完备的，该构造对固定数量参与方上的每个高效可计算经典功能给出一个带中止的 DI 协议，且安全对抗任意真子集的静态腐化。
该承诺的提取器通过经典模棱两可改变一个公开奇偶关系，并保持设备执行不变，因而其泄漏不变。承诺并证明功能、不相交审计和仿射一致性检查将认证关联与理想 OT 联系起来。发送方安全性依赖于 Magic Square 博弈的选择器感知并行重复界，我们从 Kundu 和 Tan 的两轮阈值定理推导出该界。
AI.conclusion: 仅依据摘要，作者在后量子单向函数假设下构造了设备无关不经意传输与比特承诺，并给出基于模拟、可与高效模拟器顺序组合的安全性；在隔离实验室与坐标局域测量下容忍常数率诚实设备故障，在多对数自适应泄漏与任意联合测量下容忍逆多对数率；由于 OT 对安全计算完备，还得到对固定参与方数上任意高效可计算经典功能、抗任意真子集静态腐化的带中止 DI 协议。上述结论限于摘要所述模型与假设，未提供正文结论章节，安全性未由独立材料验证。
innovations: 提出一个可同时服务于设备无关不经意传输和比特承诺的协议骨架，并覆盖两种设备故障或泄漏情形。
在后量子单向函数假设下构造具有基于模拟的安全性和顺序组合性的 DI OT 与比特承诺。
利用承诺提取器通过经典模棱两可改变公开奇偶关系而不改变设备执行及泄漏，并结合承诺并证明、不相交审计和仿射一致性检查连接认证关联与理想 OT；发送方安全性由选择器感知的 Magic Square 并行重复界支撑。

title: Unflattening by Flattening -- How Input Distributions Shape Output Variance in Angle-Encoded Circuits
summary: Barren plateaus hinder training of parameterized quantum circuits by making loss gradients exponentially small in the number of qubits. For angle-encoded product states, we show how the input distribution affects output variation through algebraic input purity, i.e. the input's overlap with the circuit's dynamical Lie algebra. With the specified readouts and Haar or exact group 2-design sampling, matchgate circuits on $n$ qubits retain output variance of order $1/n$ for every pure product input. The off-diagonal family instead has zero output on computational-basis inputs at any depth and for every parameter choice. Independent uniform angles yield mean variance of the same order as matchgates. A count of diagonal Pauli strings identifies these zero-output endpoints. For any fixed dataset of nonzero inputs with at least $2n$ coordinates, we construct a classical preprocessing certificate. A shared random rotation is accepted only when the dataset's mean purity passes a computable threshold. This certifies mean output variance of order $1/n$ for the off-diagonal family before circuit execution, with a constant expected number of trials. Binary and ternary weighted encodings also recover the independent-angle mean purity from one uniform scalar input. Numerical experiments examine training behavior and extensions to larger algebras. The guarantee concerns output variance averaged over inputs, while successful learning also depends on the task and information preserved by the encoding.

AI.abstract_zh: 贫瘠高原使损失梯度随量子比特数指数变小，从而阻碍参数化量子电路的训练。对于角度编码的乘积态，我们展示输入分布如何通过代数输入纯度（即输入与电路动力学李代数的重叠）影响输出变化。在指定读出以及 Haar 或精确群 2-设计采样下，$n$ 量子比特上的匹配门电路对每个纯乘积输入保持 $1/n$ 阶的输出方差。非对角族则在任意深度和任意参数选择下，对计算基输入的输出为零。独立均匀角度产生与匹配门同阶的平均方差。对角 Pauli 串的计数可识别这些零输出端点。对于任何至少具有 $2n$ 个坐标的非零输入固定数据集，我们构造一个经典预处理证书。仅当数据集的平均纯度通过可计算阈值时，才接受共享随机旋转。这可在执行电路之前为非对角族认证 $1/n$ 阶的平均输出方差，且期望试验次数为常数。二元和三元加权编码也能从一个均匀标量输入恢复独立角度的平均纯度。数值实验考察训练行为以及向更大代数的扩展。该保证涉及对输入平均的输出方差，而成功学习还取决于任务以及编码所保留的信息。
AI.conclusion: 该文表明，在指定读出以及 Haar 或精确群 2-设计采样假设下，输入分布通过代数输入纯度控制编码态与电路可用算符的重叠：匹配门族对每个纯乘积输入保持 Θ(1/n) 的输出方差；非对角族对计算基输入在任意深度和任意参数下输出精确为零，而独立均匀角度给出 Θ(1/n) 的平均样本方差。对于非对角链，所构造的共享随机旋转经典预处理证书可在执行量子电路前检查，固定数据集满足预处理假设时以常数期望试验次数认证逆多项式平均输出方差。零输出恒等式在任意深度的计算基重上传下保持；二元和三元加权编码可从单一均匀标量输入恢复独立角度平均纯度；在所述系综与读出假设下，指数图族的输入选择不能消除 O(2^-n) 方差上限，掺杂链的类似渐近结论依赖其组件结构。数值实验显示有限聚类宽度下的显著抑制和两种输入先验下的不同优化轨迹，但作者指出这不建立固定宽度的渐近贫瘠高原或监督学习的通用保证；结论适用于输入平均输出方差及特定可经典模拟电路族，成功学习还取决于任务和编码保留的信息。
innovations: 引入代数输入纯度（输入与电路动力学李代数的重叠），将角度编码输入分布与输出方差联系起来，并给出匹配门族和非对角族的方差标度。
构造经典预处理证书：用共享随机旋转和可计算的平均纯度阈值，在执行量子电路前认证非对角族固定数据集的 Θ(1/n) 平均输出方差，且期望试验次数为常数。
给出对角 Pauli 串计数以识别零输出端点，并证明计算基重上传下零输出恒等式在任意深度保持、二元和三元加权编码可从单一均匀标量输入恢复独立角度平均纯度。

title: Unbounded separation between definite and indefinite causal order in finite-dimensional quantum metrology
summary: Indefinite causal order is known to offer enhancements in quantum metrology, notably including an unbounded advantage in the measurement of a geometric phase of a harmonic oscillator. This advantage, however, is specific to the infinite dimensional setting, and its finite dimensional analogue remains elusive, with recent findings suggesting that advantages in finite dimensions may be fundamentally limited to bounded constant factors. Here we show that, in fact, arbitrarily large advantages arise for finite dimensional systems in the finite sample regime. Specifically, we establish an unbounded separation between definite and indefinite causal order in the estimation of a geometric phase associated to two sets of $N$ displacements generated by discrete position and momentum operators on a $d$-dimensional quantum system: for any given constant $R$, there exist values of $N$ and $d=Ω(N^2)$ such that a strategy with indefinite order uses an initial probe with $R$ times less energy than the probe required by every strategy with definite order achieving the same mean squared error, whenever the number of measurement shots $ν$ is bounded as $ν=\mathcal{O}(\exp(πd/16)/\mathrm{poly}(d))$. In other words, indefinite order offers an energy saving that grows arbitrarily large with the parameters of the problem. To prove this result, we establish an approximate Weyl relation for discrete Gaussian wavepackets, which is of independent technical interest.

AI.abstract_zh: 不定因果序已知可在量子计量中带来增强，尤其包括在谐振子几何相位测量中的无界优势。然而，这一优势特定于无限维情形，其有限维类比仍不清楚，近期结果提示有限维中的优势可能从根本上受限于有界常数因子。这里我们表明，事实上，在有限样本情形下，有限维系统也会出现任意大的优势。具体而言，我们针对一个几何相位的估计，建立了确定因果序与不定因果序之间的无界分离；该几何相位关联于由 $d$ 维量子系统上的离散位置和动量算符产生的两组各 $N$ 个位移：对任意给定常数 $R$，存在 $N$ 和 $d=\Omega(N^2)$ 的取值，使得当测量次数 $\nu$ 满足 $\nu=\mathcal{O}(\exp(\pi d/16)/\mathrm{poly}(d))$ 时，采用不定序的策略所使用的初始探针能量比每一个达到相同均方误差的确定序策略所需探针少 $R$ 倍。换言之，不定序带来的能量节省会随问题参数任意增大。为证明这一结果，我们建立了离散高斯波包的近似 Weyl 关系，这具有独立的技术意义。
AI.conclusion: 仅依据摘要，作者报告：在有限维、有限样本机制下，对于由离散位置和动量算符生成的两组各 $N$ 个位移所关联的几何相位估计，在测量次数满足给定上界时，确定因果序与不定因果序之间存在无界分离；对任意常数 $R$，存在 $N$ 与 $d=\Omega(N^2)$，使不定序策略所需初始探针能量比所有达到相同均方误差的确定序策略少 $R$ 倍。该结论限于摘要所述设定与测量次数条件；未提供正文结论章节，尚不能确认更广适用范围。
innovations: 作者表明，有限维系统在有限样本机制下也可出现任意大的不定因果序优势。
作者建立了确定因果序与不定因果序在所述几何相位估计中的无界分离，并给出能量节省随问题参数任意增大的结论。
作者为证明该结果建立了离散高斯波包的近似 Weyl 关系。

title: Zero- Versus Infinite-Temperature Damping in Variational Quantum Circuits: Feature Scale, Sampling Cost, and Frame Gauge
summary: The Pauli twirl of amplitude damping (AD) is generalized amplitude damping at infinite temperature: it keeps the contraction of AD and removes its non-unital term, so comparing the two in variational circuits isolates the zero-temperature bias, which acts mainly through the scale of the features. For random parameters, features under AD settle on a floor, which at strong damping is set by the last layer, has a closed form, and at fixed $T_1$ falls with temperature as $\tanh(\hbarω/2k_BT)$; under the twirls they shrink by a constant factor per layer, up to eight qubits. A trainable output scale removes most of the resulting accuracy differences, leaving AD ahead of its twirls by at most about three percentage points in our simulations; what it removes reappears as a cost in measurement shots: trained and tested with $10^3$ shots per image, a four-qubit classifier under AD at $p=0.3$ stays within 1.5 points of noiseless accuracy, while the twirled classifiers lose up to 33. At weaker damping the separation depth grows roughly as $(np)^{-1}\ln(1/p)$. The damping direction is a gauge when the damping follows complete entangling layers and the circuit boundaries are trainable; in an eigensolver it becomes physical inside a decomposed two-qubit gate.

AI.abstract_zh: 振幅阻尼（AD）的Pauli twirl是无穷温度下的广义振幅阻尼：它保留AD的收缩并去除其非单位项，因此在变分电路中比较二者可隔离零温偏置，而该偏置主要通过特征尺度起作用。对于随机参数，AD下的特征会落在一个地板上；在强阻尼时该地板由最后一层设定，具有闭式形式，并且在固定$T_1$时随温度按$\tanh(\hbar\omega/2k_BT)$下降；在twirl下，特征每层按恒定因子收缩，最多到八个量子比特。可训练的输出尺度消除了由此产生的大部分精度差异，在我们的模拟中使AD最多领先其twirl约三个百分点；它消除的差异又以测量采样成本的形式重新出现：以每幅图像$10^3$次采样训练和测试时，$p=0.3$下AD的四量子比特分类器与无噪声精度的差距保持在1.5个百分点以内，而twirl后的分类器最多损失33个百分点。在较弱阻尼下，分离所需深度大致按$(np)^{-1}\ln(1/p)$增长。当阻尼跟随完整的纠缠层且电路边界可训练时，阻尼方向是一种规范；在本征求解器中，当阻尼位于分解后的两量子比特门内部时，它变成物理的。
AI.conclusion: 作者比较了振幅阻尼与其twirl（尤其是无穷温度下的Pauli twirl），结论是零温偏置主要经由变分模型的特征尺度起作用：随机参数下AD特征落到地板，而twirl使特征逐层恒定收缩；可训练输出尺度在精确模拟及小规模分类任务中消除大部分拟合与精度差异，剩余差异转化为采样成本。该分离需要强阻尼或很深电路；当阻尼跟随完整纠缠层且电路边界可训练时，反转阻尼方向只是重参数化，而在阻尼被困于分解双量子门内部等情形下方向才具有物理意义。上述结论基于小规模精确模拟（拟合1个量子比特、分类器4个、本征求解器3个；训练前宽度依赖性最多到8个量子比特），训练中的采样模型忽略量子比特间关联，尚未验证硬件与更多量子比特情形。
innovations: 提出将振幅阻尼与其Pauli twirl对比，以在变分电路中隔离零温偏置，并表明该偏置主要通过特征尺度起作用。
给出随机参数下AD特征地板的闭式描述及twirl的逐层恒定收缩，并指出可训练输出尺度会把精确模拟中的多数精度差异转化为采样成本。
阐明当阻尼跟随完整纠缠层且电路边界可训练时阻尼方向是一种规范，而在分解的双量子比特门内部可成为物理效应。

title: Continuous-Process Randomized Compilation for Quantum Process Tensors
summary: Traditional discrete randomized compiling (RC) tailors errors with random control frames at logical-gate boundaries, but fails to capture intra-instrument control evolution or persistent system-environment coupling. In memory-bearing environments, errors correlate across times, not just single gates. We build continuous-process randomized compilation (CPRC) in the continuous process tensor (cPT) framework, unifying random unitary control trajectories, pointwise-covariant finite-duration instruments, and environmental dynamics on one time axis. We study four protocols: fixed Pauli refresh, bounded Cayley paths, unitary Brownian motion, Ornstein-Uhlenbeck driving. We obtain three key results: (1) Pointwise covariance ensures each trajectory exactly reproduces the target logic without system-environment coupling; a closed-frame counterexample proves endpoint-only compensation causes first-order instrument errors. (2) Independent Pauli conjugations over full intervals diagonalize error histories at boundaries, but classical labels retain environment-induced correlations, confirmed by an exact static-bath solution. (3) We derive a total-variation error bound for full adaptive output records under bounded centered coupling and mixing conditions. We prove convergence of trajectory-averaged cPT coefficients in fixed particle sectors for finite non-Gaussian environments and Gaussian baths with time-integrable covariance, including the uncut Drude spectrum. We numerically validate the theory in a qubit model via output probabilities, operator conditional mutual information, and all two-particle coefficients for both qubit and thermal Drude baths. This work extends RC from discrete circuits to continuous-time memory-bearing quantum processes, offering a unified framework, quantitative tools, implementable schemes, and benchmarks for non-Markovian error tailoring.

AI.abstract_zh: 传统离散随机编译（RC）在逻辑门边界用随机控制帧裁剪误差，但无法捕捉仪器内部的控制演化或持续的系统-环境耦合。在带记忆的环境中，误差跨时间相关，而不仅在单个门上。我们在连续过程张量（cPT）框架中构建连续过程随机编译（CPRC），将随机酉控制轨迹、逐点协变的有限时长仪器和环境动力学统一在一个时间轴上。我们研究四种协议：固定泡利刷新、有界凯莱路径、酉布朗运动、Ornstein-Uhlenbeck驱动。我们得到三个关键结果：(1) 逐点协变性确保在没有系统-环境耦合时每条轨迹都精确复现目标逻辑；一个闭帧反例证明仅端点补偿会导致一阶仪器误差。(2) 在全区间上的独立泡利共轭在边界处对角化误差历史，但经典标签保留环境诱导的关联，这由精确静态浴解证实。(3) 在有界中心耦合和混合条件下，我们推导出完整自适应输出记录的总变差误差界。我们证明在固定粒子扇区中，轨迹平均的cPT系数对于有限非高斯环境和具有时间可积协方差的高斯浴（包括未截断的Drude谱）收敛。我们在量子比特模型中通过输出概率、算子条件互信息以及量子比特浴和热Drude浴的所有两粒子系数对理论进行数值验证。这项工作将RC从离散电路扩展到连续时间带记忆的量子过程，为非马尔可夫误差裁剪提供统一框架、定量工具、可实现方案和基准。
AI.conclusion: 该工作在连续过程张量框架中建立CPRC，把随机编译从离散门或周期边界推广到连续物理时间轴上的有限时长仪器。作者给出的结论包括：无系统-环境耦合时，逐点协变实现规则使每条随机控制轨迹复现目标逻辑实验；在独立完整区间的指定边界上，泡利特征平均可对角化误差历史，但经典标签仍可能携带环境诱导关联（由两单元静态浴基准展示）；在满足所述混合假设的有界中心相互作用与控制下，完整自适应输出记录具有总变差界，并证明轨迹平均cPT系数在特定非高斯环境和满足所述物理截断实现、时间可积协方差与截断稳定性条件的高斯浴（含未截断Drude谱）下收敛。上述结论分别针对不同可观测量，适用范围受所述边界、固定时间区间、粒子扇区及物理截断/协方差/截断稳定性等条件限制；数值结果与理论图景一致。
innovations: 在连续过程张量框架中提出连续过程随机编译（CPRC），将随机酉控制轨迹、逐点协变有限时长仪器与环境动力学统一在同一连续时间轴。
给出路径逐点逻辑实现、边界受限经典化与完整记录误差控制的联合处理，并推导完整自适应输出记录的总变差界及轨迹平均cPT系数收敛结果。
提供可实现的四种控制协议与数值基准，用于非马尔可夫误差结构裁剪。

title: Efficient learning of quantum interactions from thermal metastable states
summary: Learning quantum interactions from finite-temperature many-body systems is a central task in emerging quantum platforms. Recently, the problem of learning from lattice quantum Gibbs states has found rigorous, efficient protocols. Nevertheless, exact Gibbs states, as the input premise, are in fact computationally intractable to prepare and may not faithfully represent generic finite-temperature quantum systems. In contrast, a system coupled to a heat bath can be stuck at an approximate stationary state (metastable state) long before it truly equilibrates. Here, we formulate a physically and algorithmically consistent alternative: learning from such metastable states of detailed-balanced master equations (Lindbladians) arising from system-bath interactions. We distill the algorithmic mechanism and structural condition underlying Gibbs-state learning and extend it in full to metastable states, attaining nearly optimal sample and computational complexity (in the system size and the precision). More broadly, we sharpen notions of metastability and develop a unified framework for finite-temperature learning.

AI.abstract_zh: 从有限温度多体系统学习量子相互作用是新兴量子平台中的一项核心任务。最近，从晶格量子 Gibbs 态学习的问题已经出现了严格且高效的协议。然而，作为输入前提的精确 Gibbs 态实际上在计算上难以制备，并且可能无法忠实代表一般有限温度量子系统。相比之下，一个与热浴耦合的系统可能在真正达到平衡之前很久就停留在一个近似定常态（亚稳态）上。在这里，我们提出一种在物理和算法上均一致的替代方案：从由系统—热浴相互作用产生的、满足细致平衡的主方程（Lindbladians）的此类亚稳态中学习。我们提炼了 Gibbs 态学习背后的算法机制和结构条件，并将其完整推广到亚稳态，达到（就系统尺寸和精度而言）近乎最优的样本复杂度和计算复杂度。更广泛地说，我们细化了亚稳态的概念，并建立了一个用于有限温度学习的统一框架。
AI.conclusion: 作者给出了针对满足细致平衡的 Lindbladian 的量子亚稳态的高效 Hamiltonian 学习协议，并借助近似细致平衡条件把 Gibbs 态学习框架扩展到亚稳态；该条件同时用于量化亚稳态并支撑 Hamiltonian 的可识别性。其论证主要限于弱耦合、马尔可夫热浴设定以及单格点 Pauli 跃迁的 Lindbladian；作者相信在更一般的跃迁算符和跃迁速率条件下类似结果成立，但未给出证明，且对于 Lindbladian 定常态之外的情形如何推出近似细致平衡条件仍不清楚。
innovations: 提出从系统—热浴相互作用导出的细致平衡 Lindbladian 的亚稳态中学习量子相互作用的物理与算法一致方案。
提炼 Gibbs 态学习的算法机制与结构条件，并将其完整推广到亚稳态，获得就系统尺寸和精度而言近乎最优的样本与计算复杂度。
细化亚稳态概念，并建立有限温度学习的统一框架。

title: Molecular Dynamics with Nuclear Effects on Quantum Computers
summary: Nuclear quantum effects are critical for describing proton transfer and hydrogen bonding, but their incorporation into quantum chemistry calculations is often computationally prohibitive on classical hardware. A promising alternative are quantum computers due to their linear scaling in the space requirements with system size. We introduce a novel hybrid quantum-classical algorithm for ab-initio molecular dynamics that incorporates nuclear quantum effects via the nuclear-electronic orbital method. The proposed algorithm evaluates ground state energies and forces on the quantum computer using a variational quantum eigensolver, while the molecular geometries are updated classically. We validate our approach through simulations of $\text{H}_2$, $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ and the Zundel ion $\text{H}_5\text{O}_2^+$, comparing the simulated vibrational spectra with experimental data. Upon inclusion of nuclear quantum effects, the proton shuttling movement in the Zundel ion becomes effectively barrierless, and errors in the simulated frequencies improve significantly. Employing compact hardware-efficient ansatz circuits we achieve results comparable to the more accurate UCCSD ansatzes, which hints towards the feasibility of executing our algorithm on near-term quantum devices.

AI.abstract_zh: 核量子效应对描述质子转移和氢键至关重要，但将其纳入量子化学计算在经典硬件上往往计算成本高得难以承受。一个有望的替代方案是量子计算机，因为其空间需求随系统规模线性缩放。我们提出一种新的量子-经典混合算法，用于从头算分子动力学，该算法通过核-电子轨道方法纳入核量子效应。所提算法使用变分量子本征求解器在量子计算机上评估基态能量和力，而分子几何结构则在经典计算机上更新。我们通过模拟 $\text{H}_2$、$\text{H}_2\text{O}$ 和 Zundel 离子 $\text{H}_5\text{O}_2^+$ 验证了该方法，并将模拟的振动光谱与实验数据进行比较。在纳入核量子效应后，Zundel 离子中的质子穿梭运动变得有效无垒，模拟频率的误差显著改善。采用紧凑的硬件高效拟设电路，我们获得了与更精确的 UCCSD 拟设相当的结果，这暗示了在近期量子设备上执行我们算法的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 在所提供的结论节选中，作者实现了一个混合分子动力学模拟：在量子计算机上评估分子能量和力，并在经典计算机上对原子核的经典运动方程进行积分；通过 NEO 框架纳入核量子效应，并模拟了 $\text{H}_2$、$\text{H}_2\text{O}$ 和 Zundel 离子 $\text{H}_5\text{O}_2^+$ 的振动模式。结果表明，NEO 改善了水和 Zundel 离子的简正模模拟，但 $\text{H}_2$ 的伸缩模频率被过度校正；水分子仅需 s 型核轨道，而 Zundel 离子还需要核 p 型轨道才能充分复现非谐模耦合。使用 UCCSD 拟设时混合 MD 算法结果最佳，在 5 至 7 个轨道（约 10 个量子比特）的较小活性空间下平均误差低于 5%；硬件高效拟设在显著更低的量子计算资源需求下通常与 UCCSD 结果非常接近。上述结论限于所模拟的分子、正则轨道基组和所考察的拟设；作者预期自然轨道基组可改进资源使用或精度，并强调正确确定活性电子轨道和核轨道对可靠准确预测至关重要。
innovations: 提出一种新的量子-经典混合从头算分子动力学算法，通过核-电子轨道方法纳入核量子效应，并在量子计算机上评估基态能量与力、在经典计算机上更新分子几何。
采用紧凑的硬件高效拟设电路，在 $\text{H}_2$、$\text{H}_2\text{O}$ 和 Zundel 离子模拟中获得与更精确 UCCSD 拟设相当的结果，作者据此指出这暗示了在近期量子设备上执行的可行性。

title: Efficient certification of time-reversal symmetry requires entanglement
summary: Time-reversal symmetry is a fundamental principle of physics describing the invariance of physical laws under reversal of the direction of time. We formulate a Bell-inequality-like test of this antiunitary symmetry using only forward access and trusted quantum operations: entanglement converts temporal input--output relations into measurable spatial exchange symmetry. For $n$-qubit unitary dynamics, we prove that reliably distinguishing the time-reversal-symmetric circular ensembles from Haar-random dynamics requires $Ω(\min\{2^{n/2},2^{n-e}\})$ queries for any classically adaptive protocol. Here, $e=\min\{e_{\mathrm s},e_{\mathrm m}\}$ with $e_{\mathrm s}$ and $e_{\mathrm m}$ representing the probe and measurement logarithmic entanglement negativities, respectively. Maximally entangled probes and SWAP measurements reduce this cost to a constant number of queries. Furthermore, we develop a time-reversal symmetry test for arbitrary fixed, compatible probes and measurements, relate its query complexity to their logarithmic negativities, and match the lower-bound scaling in the high-entanglement regime by optimizing the probe and measurement. Our results establish a quantitative connection between entanglement and time-reversal symmetry, bridging two central concepts in quantum information science and fundamental physics.

AI.abstract_zh: 时间反演对称性是物理学的基本原理，描述物理定律在时间方向反转下的不变性。我们仅使用前向访问和可信量子操作，构建了一种类似贝尔不等式的检验来测试这种反幺正对称性：纠缠将时间性的输入—输出关系转化为可测量的空间交换对称性。对于 $n$ 量子比特幺正动力学，我们证明，对于任何经典自适应协议，要可靠区分时间反演对称的圆系综与 Haar 随机动力学，需要 $Ω(\min\{2^{n/2},2^{n-e}\})$ 次查询。这里，$e=\min\{e_{\mathrm s},e_{\mathrm m}\}$，其中 $e_{\mathrm s}$ 和 $e_{\mathrm m}$ 分别表示探针和测量的对数纠缠负度。最大纠缠探针和 SWAP 测量将该成本降低到常数次查询。此外，我们为任意固定且兼容的探针和测量开发了一种时间反演对称性检验，将其查询复杂度与它们的对数负度联系起来，并通过优化探针和测量在高纠缠区域匹配下界的标度。我们的结果在纠缠与时间反演对称性之间建立了定量联系，连接了量子信息科学与基础物理中的两个核心概念。
AI.conclusion: 作者结论是，对称性的经验内容取决于观察者可制备和测量的关联；在仅前向访问、操作可信的有限维 $n$ 量子比特幺正动力学中，纠缠探针将动力学时间反演对称性映射为扩大的二分态上的幺正交换对称性，从而把时间性输入—输出关系转化为可测空间关联。其证明的查询下界为 $Ω(\min\{2^{n/2},2^{n-e}\})$，适用于任意经典自适应协议；最大纠缠探针与 SWAP 测量可将查询成本降至常数，并在高纠缠区通过优化探针和测量匹配下界标度。开放子系统、有限温度/全息扩展及真实对称性破缺与访问丢失的区分仍属待研究范围，结论不声称已实验验证或适用于这些扩展。
innovations: 提出一种仅使用前向访问和可信量子操作的、类似贝尔不等式的时间反演对称性检验，用纠缠把时间性输入—输出关系转化为可测量的空间交换对称性。
证明对 $n$ 量子比特幺正动力学，任意经典自适应协议可靠区分时间反演对称圆系综与 Haar 随机动力学需要 $Ω(\min\{2^{n/2},2^{n-e}\})$ 次查询，并表明最大纠缠探针与 SWAP 测量可将成本降至常数次查询。
为任意固定且兼容的探针和测量建立时间反演对称性检验，将查询复杂度与探针和测量的对数纠缠负度联系，并在高纠缠区通过优化匹配下界标度。

title: Adversarial Robustness in Fake Quantum Simulators
summary: This paper investigates the performance scalability and adversarial robustness of Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models deployed on noise-model-based fake simulators. We conduct a dual-phased study, first benchmarking the computational throughput of Qiskit's Aer simulation engine across varying hardware architectures, and second, evaluating the effectiveness of Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) attacks and adversarial retraining strategies under realistic noise conditions. Our results quantify the runtime tradeoffs and scaling behavior for medium-scale simulations (projected up to 8 qubits) and demonstrate that high adversarial-to-benign retraining ratios (50/50) are essential for achieving practical model robustness for 4-qubit classifiers under realistic noise conditions.

AI.abstract_zh: 本文研究了部署在基于噪声模型的假模拟器上的量子机器学习（QML）模型的性能可扩展性与对抗鲁棒性。我们开展了一项双阶段研究：首先，对Qiskit的Aer模拟引擎在不同硬件架构上的计算吞吐量进行基准测试；其次，评估在真实噪声条件下投影梯度下降（PGD）攻击与对抗重训练策略的有效性。我们的结果量化了中等规模模拟（预计最高可达8个量子比特）的运行时间权衡与扩展行为，并表明在真实噪声条件下，对于4量子比特分类器，高对抗样本-良性样本重训练比例（50/50）对于实现实际模型鲁棒性至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 作者在模拟噪声环境中评估了QML模型的性能可扩展性和对抗鲁棒性，结论认为：噪声器件的密度矩阵模拟计算开销较大，但多核并行化和选用优化的Aer求解器方法使此类研究在现代经典硬件上可行；量子比特数从4增至8时，运行时间约增加10.86倍。对抗安全方面，PGD白盒扰动可将噪声环境下的分类准确率降至低至12%；低比例对抗样本重训练恢复有限，而50/50对抗-良性样本重训练可将鲁棒准确率恢复至84%；Lipschitz梯度正则化相较10%黄金样本重训练基线（44%）取得20个百分点的绝对提升（达到64%）；非线性特征映射等架构选择可能反而增加梯度攻击脆弱性，重训练后鲁棒准确率降至24%。这些结论适用于所研究的中尺度模拟和噪声条件，作者据此强调需协同设计QNN架构与训练协议以实现NISQ时代的实际安全性。
innovations: 作者采用双阶段研究，先基准测试Qiskit Aer在不同硬件架构上的计算吞吐，再在真实噪声条件下评估PGD攻击与对抗重训练。
作者量化了量子比特数从4增至8时约10.86倍的运行时间扩展因子。
作者报告了50/50对抗-良性重训练及Lipschitz梯度正则化对鲁棒准确率的提升效果。

title: Electromagnetic Side-Channel Vulnerability in QKD Equipment
summary: Actual quantum key distribution network nodes may be vulnerable to side-channel attacks such as electromagnetic leakage. In this study, we measured electromagnetic emissions from a prototype quantum key distribution device implementing a time-bin decoy-state BB84 protocol with Y and Z bases. We measured the electromagnetic spectra and waveforms at distances of 0 m and 3 m from the transmitter and receiver inside an anechoic chamber. The results showed that the transmitter was the primary source of electromagnetic leakage, and distinct differences were observed between the quantum states generated at the third harmonic of the 1241.6 MHz clock.

AI.abstract_zh: 实际的量子密钥分发网络节点可能容易受到电磁泄漏等侧信道攻击。在本研究中，我们测量了一台原型量子密钥分发设备的电磁发射，该设备实现了使用 Y 基和 Z 基的时间仓诱骗态 BB84 协议。我们在电波暗室内，测量了距发射端和接收端 0 m 和 3 m 处的电磁频谱和波形。结果表明，发射端是电磁泄漏的主要来源，并且在 1241.6 MHz 时钟的三次谐波处生成的量子态之间观察到了明显差异。
AI.conclusion: 摘要仅报告了针对一台实现时间仓诱骗态 BB84 协议的原型量子密钥分发设备的电磁侧信道测量：发射端是主要电磁泄漏源，且在 1241.6 MHz 时钟三次谐波处生成的量子态之间存在明显差异；现有材料未明确给出更一般性的结论或适用范围。

title: Dissipation-Enabled Operator-Norm Locality Bounds for Bose-Hubbard Hamiltonians
summary: Closed bosonic lattice systems do not generally admit operator norm Lieb--Robinson bounds uniformly in the initial state. The reason is that the information propagation velocity can grow with the local boson occupancy, which can be macroscopically large. Here, we show that local dissipation restores an operator-norm Lieb--Robinson bound. We consider the dissipative Bose--Hubbard model described by a Lindbladian operator with on-site $\ell$-photon loss, $\ell>2$ and, for our main result, we establish an almost-ballistic Lieb-Robinson bound. Dissipation rapidly depletes highly occupied sites, thus regularizing the state on the Sobolev-type scale of local particle moments. The resulting moment bounds diverge as time approaches zero but remain integrable near zero at sufficiently low orders. We extend these ideas to treat cat-code dissipation and, for initial states in the code space, we prove a local adiabatic approximation uniform in the total volume. Further consequences include local channel approximation, a thermodynamic limit, and efficient digital quantum simulation. The point is that these applications are now available \textit{uniformly in the input state}, as for quantum spin systems, but in contrast to closed Bose--Hubbard systems.

AI.abstract_zh: 封闭玻色子晶格系统通常不允许与初始态无关的算子范数 Lieb–Robinson 界。原因是信息传播速度可能随局部玻色子占据数增长，而该占据数可达到宏观尺度。这里，我们证明局域耗散可恢复算子范数 Lieb–Robinson 界。我们考虑由带有在位 $\ell$-光子损耗（$\ell>2$）的 Lindblad 算子描述的耗散 Bose–Hubbard 模型，并针对我们的主要结果建立近弹道 Lieb–Robinson 界。耗散会迅速耗尽高占据位点，从而在局部粒子矩的 Sobolev 型尺度上正则化状态。所得的矩界在时间趋于零时发散，但在足够低阶时于零附近仍可积。我们将这些思想推广到处理猫码耗散，并且对于码空间中的初始态，证明在总体积上一致的局部绝热近似。进一步的推论包括局部信道近似、热力学极限以及高效的数字量子模拟。关键在于，这些应用现在对输入态一致可用，正如量子自旋系统那样，但与封闭 Bose–Hubbard 系统形成对比。
AI.conclusion: 作者表明，在其 Lindblad 耗散设定中，在位多光子损耗（$\ell>2$）可对耗散 Bose–Hubbard 模型在所有输入态上一致地恢复算子范数 Lieb–Robinson 局域性，并由此得到局部信道近似与不依赖初始矩假设的定量热力学极限；对带移位四光子损耗的四次相互作用，作者给出猫码空间初态下体积一致的局部绝热近似，并在 $\ell>3$ 时结合物理损耗制备与占据检验得到对任意输入具有显式 diamond 范数误差界的杂化玻色–量子比特模拟方案。该结论受其模型与损耗阶数假设限制，双光子损耗是否也给出对所有输入态一致的局域性仍为开放问题；所得界对应固定精度下的近弹道传播，有限速度指数光锥仍未解决。
innovations: 证明在位多光子损耗（$\ell>2$）可恢复耗散 Bose–Hubbard 模型的算子范数 Lieb–Robinson 局域性，且对所有输入态一致。
利用矩正则化与自适应截断控制零时刻奇异性，并据此得到局部信道近似和不依赖初始矩假设的定量热力学极限。
将方法推广到猫码耗散，对码空间初态给出体积一致的局部绝热近似，并在 $\ell>3$ 时给出具有显式 diamond 范数误差界的杂化玻色–量子比特模拟方案。

title: A Code-Agnostic Graph Neural Network Decoder from the Detection Error Model
summary: We present POLYMECHANON, a graph neural network (GNN) decoder for quantum error correction whose only input is the detection error model (DEM) of a quantum code under a given noise model. We represent the DEM as a tripartite graph of detectors, error mechanisms and logical observables, where every input feature is computed by using the quantum code as data rather than design choice. In this way, the same architecture decodes in principle any stabiliser code, under any noise model that can be expressed as a detection error model, once trained on the DEM. We test this approach along four directions. Firstly, on the rotated surface code the decoder outperforms correlated MWPM under both phenomenological and circuit-level noise, with up to $25\%$ fewer logical failures. Secondly, on a family of high-rate qLDPC codes it matches BP+OSD on the smaller codes and surpasses it on the larger ones, with up to $16\%$ fewer logical failures on $[\![130,4,6]\!]$. Thirdly, its decoding time does not depend on the physical error rate, whereas that of BP+OSD grows with it: on $[\![130,4,6]\!]$ its effective cost per shot is of the order of a few ms on a single GPU against a few tens of milliseconds for BP+OSD on a single CPU core, and its fixed computational graph makes it a candidate for real-time decoding on neutral-atom processors. Finally, a single model trained across codes of different families outperforms uncorrelated MWPM on the graph-like codes seen during training and stays within $10\%$ of BP+OSD on the others, while it tends to fail to generalize to unseen codes, particularly larger ones. Its probabilistic output enables confidence-based post-selection, lowering the logical error rate by more than an order of magnitude on the surface code while keeping more than $90\%$ of the shots. Since only the DEM changes, new codes and noise models can be decoded without redesigning the decoder.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出了 POLYMECHANON，一种用于量子纠错的图神经网络（GNN）解码器，其唯一输入是给定噪声模型下量子码的检测错误模型（DEM）。我们将 DEM 表示为检测器、错误机制和逻辑可观测量的三部图，其中每个输入特征都通过把量子码作为数据来计算，而不是作为设计选择。这样，同一架构原则上可在任何能表示为检测错误模型的噪声模型下解码任何稳定子码，只需在 DEM 上训练。我们沿四个方向测试了该方法。首先，在旋转表面码上，该解码器在现象学噪声和电路级噪声下均优于相关 MWPM，逻辑失败最多减少 $25\%$。其次，在一族高速率 qLDPC 码上，它在较小码上与 BP+OSD 相当，在较大码上超过 BP+OSD，在 $[\![130,4,6]\!]$ 上逻辑失败最多减少 $16\%$。第三，其解码时间不依赖物理错误率，而 BP+OSD 的解码时间随物理错误率增长：在 $[\![130,4,6]\!]$ 上，单块 GPU 上每次采样的有效成本为几毫秒量级，而单 CPU 核上的 BP+OSD 为几十毫秒量级；其固定计算图使其成为在中性原子处理器上实时解码的候选方案。最后，一个在不同码族的不同码上训练的单一模型，在训练中见过的图状码上优于不相关 MWPM，在其他码上与 BP+OSD 的差距保持在 $10\%$ 以内，但它往往无法泛化到未见过的码，尤其是较大的码。其概率输出支持基于置信度的后选择，在表面码上将逻辑错误率降低超过一个数量级，同时保留超过 $90\%$ 的采样。由于只有 DEM 发生变化，新码和新噪声模型无需重新设计解码器即可解码。
AI.conclusion: 作者报告，该 GNN 解码器直接以检测错误模型为输入，具有码无关结构，原则上适用于任何可编译为 DEM 的稳定子码；在作者测试的旋转表面码上，它在现象学噪声下直至 d=9、在电路级噪声下直至 d=7 的各距离均优于相关 MWPM，并在 LaCross k=2 族上达到或超过 BP+OSD，且优势随码规模增大。其每次采样成本不依赖物理错误率，因而比 BP+OSD 更便宜；概率输出可用于基于置信度的后选择；更换码、码族或噪声模型无需改变网络，只需新 DEM 和新的训练运行。适用范围限于作者所测试的码、噪声模型与训练设置；通用模型对未见码尤其较大码的泛化仍有限。
innovations: 提出仅以检测错误模型为输入的码无关 GNN 解码器，原则上可解码任何能编译为 DEM 的稳定子码。
在旋转表面码和高速率 qLDPC 码上报告了相对相关 MWPM 与 BP+OSD 的逻辑失败优势。
报告了解码时间不依赖物理错误率，且概率输出支持基于置信度的后选择。

title: Mentor-Initiated Asymmetric Bidirectional Quantum Teleportation Protocol for Arbitrary Qubit States
summary: In this paper, a mentor-initiated bidirectional asymmetric quantum teleportation protocol is proposed. Unlike existing schemes that restrict the two-qubit state transmitted from Bob to Alice to a Bell-like form $α|00\rangle+β|11\rangle$, our protocol allows an arbitrary two-qubit state to be teleported from Bob to Alice within the mentor-initiated framework. The required entangled resources are constructed using standard quantum gates, and the protocol is illustrated through its quantum-circuit implementation in Qiskit.

AI.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种由导师发起（mentor-initiated）的双向非对称量子隐形传态协议。与现有方案将 Bob 发送给 Alice 的两量子比特态限制为类贝尔形式 $α|00\rangle+β|11\rangle$ 不同，我们的协议允许在导师发起框架下将任意两量子比特态从 Bob 隐形传态至 Alice。所需的纠缠资源使用标准量子门构造，并通过在 Qiskit 中的量子线路实现对该协议进行了说明。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了导师发起的非对称双向量子隐形传态协议，可同时完成 Alice 向 Bob 的任意单量子比特态交换与 Bob 向 Alice 的任意两量子比特态交换；其优势在于适用于任意两量子比特态，而近期导师型协议仅限特定类贝尔态，且该协议仅依赖标准两体贝尔基测量、无需复杂多量子比特联合测量。作者通过 Qiskit 量子线路模拟验证了理论框架，确认状态交换的可行性与鲁棒性；引入监督授权机制用于安全量子网络属于未来展望，尚未在本文中验证。
innovations: 提出一种导师发起的非对称双向量子隐形传态协议，可同时交换 Alice 到 Bob 的任意单量子比特态和 Bob 到 Alice 的任意两量子比特态。
相较近期导师型协议仅适用于特定类贝尔态，该方案可适用于任意两量子比特态。
协议操作直接，仅使用标准两体贝尔基测量，避免复杂多量子比特联合测量。

title: Predicting electric-field noise in ion traps using fluctuation electrodynamics
summary: Electric-field noise in microfabricated surface ion traps contributes to gate errors in trapped-ion quantum computers, but this noise has been challenging to predict. Here, we present a method to predict the electric-field noise arising from fluctuations in the bulk of dielectric and metallic materials. The method is valid for arbitrary trap geometries, and the only relevant material property is energy loss. We apply it to an ion trap with an electrically floating electrode and find the contribution from dielectrics to be dominant. Our model predicts the observed noise for this trap within a factor of four. In addition, we apply our model to typical surface trap designs and analyze how the electrode structures shield the noise.

AI.abstract_zh: 微纳加工表面离子阱中的电场噪声会导致囚禁离子量子计算机的门误差，但这种噪声一直难以预测。本文提出一种方法，用于预测由介电材料和金属材料体材料内部涨落引起的电场噪声。该方法适用于任意阱几何结构，且唯一相关的材料性质是能量损耗。我们将其应用于一个带有电浮置电极的离子阱，发现介电材料的贡献占主导。我们的模型对该阱观测到的噪声的预测在相差不超过四倍的范围内。此外，我们将模型应用于典型表面阱设计，并分析电极结构如何屏蔽噪声。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出并应用有限元分析（FEA）方法分析离子阱中的电场噪声，该方法同时考虑介电材料和导电材料，可对给定阱的电场噪声与离子加热率作出定量预测；在带电气浮置金属线的表面离子阱中，当介电损耗角正切作为自由参数时，模型与实验相符，且浮置线使衬底介电噪声传播至离子并成为主导噪声源。作者还模拟了典型表面离子阱沿三个阱轴的加热率，改变沟槽深度、沟槽宽度和底切宽度，并识别出阱设计无法充分屏蔽介电组件的参数区间；作者认为该方法可用于与实测数据比较、评估现有离子阱的材料选择与制造工艺，并作为迭代设计工具，使体材料对粒子加热的贡献低于目标值并得到充分理解。其适用性主要针对表面离子阱及类似几何的噪声与加热率预测，示例中的定量一致性依赖于将介电损耗角正切作为自由参数等条件。
innovations: 提出一种基于有限元分析的方法，可预测任意阱几何中由介电和金属材料体材料涨落引起的电场噪声与离子加热率。
该方法同时考虑介电材料和导电材料，而不仅是介电材料，并能给出可与实验比较的定量预测。
利用带电气浮置金属线的表面离子阱表征衬底介电噪声，并系统分析沟槽深度、宽度和底切宽度对屏蔽效果的影响。

title: Efficiently Optimizing the Quantum Value of Bell Inequalities using Batched Gradient Descent
summary: Exploring the world of Bell inequalities requires numerical methods that scale effectively with the number of parties, inputs, and outputs. Such methods can be used to study large-scale Bell inequalities beyond the reach of analytic methods, to design experiments for violating more complicated Bell inequalities, and to enable applications of Bell inequality violation. Such applications include randomness generation and multi-agent coordination with restricted communication. However, current general purpose optimizers such as the see-saw method struggle to handle Bell inequalities with only a dozen inputs and outputs. We introduce an optimizer for the quantum value of a Bell inequality based on batched gradient descent (BGD). More precisely, our BGD optimizer is a differentiable search over feasible quantum strategies in which states and projective measurements are generated from unconstrained variables. The Bell expression is evaluated by a direct tensor contraction without forming the prohibitively large Bell operator. This formulation makes parallel random restarts inexpensive and is thus naturally implemented by a GPU. We evaluate our optimizer against the see-saw method and find a significant speedup for a wide variety of Bell inequality families. Implemented on a GPU, our BGD optimizer can optimize Bell inequalities in our numerical experiments with more than a thousand inputs or outputs within minutes. For these large-scale Bell inequalities, we also efficiently compute the classical value by enumerating possible strategies using a GPU or expressing the optimization as a mixed-integer linear program. Our optimizers can serve as numerical evaluation tools for Bell experiments and multi-agent coordination problems modeled by Bell inequalities with many inputs and outputs, a common feature of real-world scenarios such as high frequency trading and distributed systems.

AI.abstract_zh: 探索贝尔不等式的世界需要能够随参与方、输入和输出数量有效扩展的数值方法。此类方法可用于研究超出解析方法能力的大规模贝尔不等式、设计违反更复杂贝尔不等式的实验，以及实现贝尔不等式违反的应用。此类应用包括随机数生成和受限通信下的多智能体协调。然而，当前诸如跷跷板方法（see-saw method）之类的通用优化器难以处理仅有十几个输入和输出的贝尔不等式。我们介绍一种基于批量梯度下降（BGD）的贝尔不等式量子值优化器。更准确地说，我们的BGD优化器是在可行量子策略上进行可微搜索，其中状态和投影测量由无约束变量生成。贝尔表达式通过直接张量收缩来求值，而无需构造大得难以处理的贝尔算符。这种表述使并行随机重启成本低廉，因而自然可由GPU实现。我们将我们的优化器与跷跷板方法进行评估比较，发现在多种贝尔不等式族上都有显著加速。在GPU上实现后，我们的BGD优化器可以在数分钟内优化我们数值实验中输入或输出超过一千的贝尔不等式。对于这些大规模贝尔不等式，我们还通过使用GPU枚举可能策略或将优化表示为混合整数线性规划来高效计算经典值。我们的优化器可作为贝尔实验以及由具有许多输入和输出的贝尔不等式建模的多智能体协调问题的数值评估工具，而这是高频交易和分布式系统等真实世界场景的常见特征。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出一种基于批量梯度下降（BGD）的优化器，用于计算一般非局域博弈的量子值下界：它通过直接张量收缩评估期望效用，避免构造稠密的 d^{n_p}×d^{n_p} 贝尔算符，从而处理超出跷跷板方法等标准数值方法能力的问题规模。在数值实验中，该优化器能以高精度恢复已解族的量子值，并对未解族计算高质量下界；由于每次迭代成本主要由与加权效用张量的收缩决定，而非重复求解稠密特征问题，它在多种贝尔不等式族上显著快于现成的跷跷板实现，并借助GPU批量重启在数秒内给出估计。但该方法未消除对参与方数量 n_p 的指数依赖：加权效用张量 W 有 (n_in n_out)^{n_p} 个条目，量子态也以 d^{n_p} 个复振幅显式表示，因此存储和收缩仍随参与方数指数增长。作者指出未来可利用博弈描述中的稀疏性、对称性或局域性，采用结构化变分族或张量网络表示浅层电路制备的态与测量，也可用基于采样的score-function（REINFORCE）估计松弛对加权效用张量的显式依赖。该优化器可作为贝尔实验和可建模为非局域博弈的多智能体协调问题的数值评估工具，但实际应用仍需基于真实数据的效用函数与输入分布，且当前结论限于作者数值实验所覆盖的贝尔不等式族与问题规模。
innovations: 提出基于批量梯度下降（BGD）的贝尔不等式量子值优化器，通过直接张量收缩评估贝尔表达式，避免构造稠密的大贝尔算符。
在可行量子策略上进行可微搜索，状态和投影测量由无约束变量生成，使并行随机重启成本低廉并自然在GPU上实现。
在多种贝尔不等式族上相比跷跷板方法实现显著加速，并能在数分钟内优化输入或输出超过一千的贝尔不等式。

title: Exact first-detection probability in a locally monitored solvable quantum circuit
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures; Supplemental Material: 19 pages, 4 figures
summary: We study the interplay between local stroboscopic measurements and the unitary quantum circuit dynamics of the deterministic Floquet-quantum East model. We derive exact analytical results for the probability of first detecting a subset of qubits back in their initial state. This is achieved via a renewal equation linking the first-detection probability to the subsystem Loschmidt echo, which encodes the effective open dynamics of the monitored qubits. The resulting statistics exhibit two regimes set by the competition between the measurement probing time and the relaxation timescale of the unitary circuit dynamics: while infrequent monitoring leads to geometric first-detection statistics, frequent monitoring induces correlations that manifest as deviations from this geometric behavior. These results provide a rare exact characterization of how local measurement backaction reshapes detection statistics in an interacting quantum many-body system. In our local protocol, return probabilities are controlled by the size of the monitored subregion and can therefore be accessed on digital quantum simulators via local mid-circuit measurements.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们研究局域频闪测量与确定性 Floquet 量子 East 模型的幺正量子电路动力学之间的相互作用。我们推导了首次探测到一组量子比特回到其初始态的概率的精确解析结果。这是通过一个更新方程实现的，该方程将首次探测概率与子系统 Loschmidt 回波联系起来，而子系统 Loschmidt 回波编码了被监测量子比特的有效开放动力学。所得统计呈现出两种区间，由测量探测时间与幺正电路动力学的弛豫时间尺度之间的竞争决定：不频繁监测导致几何式首次探测统计，而频繁监测会引入关联，表现为对这类几何行为的偏离。这些结果为局域测量反作用如何重塑相互作用量子多体系统中的探测统计提供了罕见的精确刻画。在我们的局域协议中，返回概率由被监测子区域的大小控制，因此可以在数字量子模拟器上通过局域中途测量获取。
AI.conclusion: 所提供的正文结论节选主要是补充材料中的张量网络符号约定，未给出额外研究结论；依据摘要，作者报告了确定性 Floquet 量子 East 模型在局域频闪测量下首次探测概率的精确解析结果，并通过将首次探测概率与子系统 Loschmidt 回波联系的更新方程刻画被监测量子比特的有效开放动力学。作者指出，统计由测量探测时间与幺正电路弛豫时间尺度的竞争分为两种区间：不频繁监测给出几何式首次探测统计，频繁监测则因关联而偏离该几何行为；作者认为这为相互作用量子多体系统中局域测量反作用如何重塑探测统计提供了罕见的精确刻画。局域协议中的返回概率由被监测子区域大小控制，并可在数字量子模拟器上通过局域中途测量获取。
innovations: 作者给出了确定性 Floquet 量子 East 模型在局域频闪测量下首次探测到量子比特子集回到初始态的精确解析结果。
作者通过将首次探测概率与子系统 Loschmidt 回波联系起来的更新方程，刻画被监测量子比特的有效开放动力学。
作者识别出由测量探测时间与幺正电路弛豫时间尺度竞争决定的两种统计区间，并指出局域协议中的返回概率可由被监测子区域大小控制、可在数字量子模拟器上通过局域中途测量获取。

title: Less precise but less noisy: local circuits for momentum-space state preparation and measurement
summary: Quantum algorithms are usually optimized for gate count or circuit depth. We find on Quantinuum System Model H2 quantum computer that for a tight-binding chain ground state preparation, there is a system size $N$ beyond which the adiabatic evolution reaches significantly lower energies than the Fermionic Fourier Transform (FFT), with the same number of gates, and with the same circuit depth. We attribute this high noise sensitivity of the FFT to its high precision, being able to distinguish momenta by $1/N$. This high resolution in momentum space requires long-range couplings in real space, which propagates errors faster. In contrast, although local and physical circuits such as the adiabatic evolution have a coarser momentum resolution, they also propagate errors more slowly. For physical applications, high momentum resolution is rarely required and is often worth trading for low noise sensitivity. We also introduce a momentum measurement scheme that although less precise than FFT, is less costly and less noisy. We show that it achieves better performance than FFT for spectral function measurement on Quantinuum System Model H2 quantum computer. Our work emphasizes the importance of reducing the noise sensitivity of quantum algorithms, beyond the number of gates or circuit depth.

AI.abstract_zh: 量子算法通常针对门数或电路深度进行优化。我们在 Quantinuum System Model H2 量子计算机上发现，对于紧束缚链基态制备，存在一个系统尺寸 $N$，超过该尺寸后，在门数相同且电路深度相同的情况下，绝热演化达到的能量显著低于费米子傅里叶变换（FFT）。我们将 FFT 的这种高噪声敏感性归因于其高精度，即能够以 $1/N$ 区分动量。动量空间中的这种高分辨率需要在实空间中使用长程耦合，而长程耦合会使误差传播得更快。相反，诸如绝热演化这样的局域且物理的电路虽然动量分辨率较粗，但误差传播也更慢。对于物理应用，很少需要高动量分辨率，并且通常值得用低噪声敏感性来换取。我们还引入了一种动量测量方案，尽管它不如 FFT 精确，但成本更低且噪声更小。我们表明，在 Quantinuum System Model H2 量子计算机上，对于谱函数测量，它取得了比 FFT 更好的性能。我们的工作强调了降低量子算法噪声敏感性的重要性，而不仅仅是门数或电路深度。
AI.conclusion: 在 Quantinuum H2-2 上针对自由费米子紧束缚链的基态制备与谱函数测量，FFT 因追求高动量分辨率而更易受噪声影响；当系统尺寸超过约 $N\approx 20$ 时，在相同门数下绝热演化可获得更低的基态能量密度。作者据此提出以局域电路换取较低动量精度和较低噪声敏感性的替代方案，并在谱函数测量中正确恢复了峰位；利用经典优化参数化电路在 48 个量子比特上制备了低能态，其能量对应逆温度 $\beta=3.65$ 的热态。该结论限于所研究的模型和硬件演示，未主张普遍优越性。
innovations: 作者指出，除门数和电路深度外，算法对噪声的敏感性也是量子算法设计的重要指标。
作者提出一种精度较低但成本更低、噪声更小的动量测量方案，并在 H2 上用于谱函数测量。
作者展示在相同门数下，局域绝热演化在系统尺寸超过约 $N\approx 20$ 后可较 FFT 达到更低的基态能量。

title: Near-optimal quantum query lower bounds on bipartiteness and expansion testing in the bounded-degree graph model
summary: In this work, we study bipartiteness and expansion testing, two canonical problems in graph property testing in the bounded-degree model through the lens of quantum query complexity. In the classical setting, it is known that $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{N})$ queries are necessary and sufficient for both these testing problems (Goldreich and Ron, 1999, 2000 & 2002), where $N$ denotes the number of vertices of the input graph. Due to their significance, (Ambainis, Childs, and Liu, 2011) initiated the study of these problems in the quantum setting and designed quantum algorithms for bipartiteness and expansion testing that perform $\widetilde{O}(N^{1/3})$ queries, showing a polynomial speedup. They also proved that $\widetildeΩ(N^{1/4})$ queries are necessary for expansion testing, but the possibility of an exponential quantum advantage for bipartiteness testing remained open. Despite significant effort, there has been no improvement in these results in the last decade and a half. In this work, we prove essentially tight $\widetildeΩ(N^{1/3})$ quantum query lower bounds for both bipartiteness and expansion testing, thereby completely characterizing the quantum query complexity of these problems up to polylogarithmic factors. While our proofs use the polynomial method similarly to Ambainis, Childs, and Liu, we use intermediate problems that we relate to the main problems via reductions, and perform a more precise analysis of the resulting polynomials, leading to the near-optimal lower bounds.

AI.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们从量子查询复杂度的角度研究有界度模型下图性质测试中的两个经典问题：二部性测试和扩张性测试。在经典情形下，已知这两个测试问题都需要且仅需要 $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{N})$ 次查询（Goldreich and Ron, 1999, 2000 & 2002），其中 $N$ 表示输入图的顶点数。由于这些问题的重要性，(Ambainis, Childs, and Liu, 2011) 开创了量子情形下对这些问题的研究，并设计了用于二部性测试和扩张性测试的量子算法，其执行 $\widetilde{O}(N^{1/3})$ 次查询，显示出多项式加速。他们还证明了扩张性测试需要 $\widetildeΩ(N^{1/4})$ 次查询，但二部性测试是否存在指数级量子优势仍然悬而未决。尽管付出了显著努力，在过去十五年中这些结果没有取得改进。在这项工作中，我们证明了二部性测试和扩张性测试的本质紧的 $\widetildeΩ(N^{1/3})$ 量子查询下界，从而在 polylog 因子范围内完全刻画了这些问题的量子查询复杂度。虽然我们的证明与 Ambainis、Childs 和 Liu 类似地使用了多项式方法，但我们使用了通过归约与主问题相联系的中间问题，并对所得多项式进行了更精确的分析，从而得到了近最优下界。
AI.conclusion: 摘要给出的结论是：在有界度图模型下，作者对二部性测试和扩张性测试证明了本质紧的 $\widetildeΩ(N^{1/3})$ 量子查询下界，从而在 polylog 因子范围内完全刻画了这两个问题的量子查询复杂度；该结论基于中间问题、归约以及对所得多项式的更精细分析，适用范围为摘要所述有界度图模型中的这两个测试问题。
innovations: 证明了二部性测试与扩张性测试的本质紧 $\widetildeΩ(N^{1/3})$ 量子查询下界。
在 polylog 因子范围内完全刻画了这两个问题的量子查询复杂度。
通过将中间问题归约到主问题并对所得多项式进行更精细分析来获得近最优下界。

title: Efficient quantum phase estimation with adaptive entanglement-assisted Hadamard test
summary: The entanglement-assisted Hadamard test (EHT) is a practical method for estimating a quantum phase by amplifying the phase signal. However, the feasible amplification is fundamentally limited by the accuracy of the reference phase, such that the method is inefficient in the high-precision regime. In this work, we propose an algorithm, called adaptive entanglement-assisted Hadamard test (AEHT), that iteratively refines the reference phase, enabling progressively stronger amplification as the iteration goes by. We further consider the imperfect eigenstate preparation scenario, where a systematic bias is unavoidable when estimating the quantum phase with the conventional EHT. Such a bias can be suppressed by the proposed AEHT. Moreover, taking physical implementation into consideration, we adopt device-restart count to measure the cost of quantum phase estimation, rather than shot count. The numerical experiments confirm the effectiveness of the proposed AEHT compared with conventional methods under this measure. By unlocking the full amplification power of large entangled states, this work offers an efficient method to estimate high-precision quantum phase on near-term quantum processors.

AI.abstract_zh: 纠缠辅助 Hadamard 测试（EHT）是一种通过放大相位信号来估计量子相位的实用方法。然而，可行的放大从根本上受参考相位精度的限制，使得该方法在高精度区间效率不高。在本工作中，我们提出一种称为自适应纠缠辅助 Hadamard 测试（AEHT）的算法，它迭代地精化参考相位，随着迭代进行可实现逐步更强的放大。我们进一步考虑本征态制备不完美的情形，此时使用传统 EHT 估计量子相位时系统偏差不可避免。所提出的 AEHT 可以抑制这种偏差。此外，考虑到物理实现，我们采用设备重启次数而非采样次数来衡量量子相位估计的成本。数值实验证实，在此度量下，所提出的 AEHT 相比传统方法有效。通过释放大型纠缠态的完整放大能力，本工作为在近期量子处理器上估计高精度量子相位提供了一种高效方法。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出 AEHT，通过迭代精化参考相位实现逐步增强的 GHZ 态放大，克服传统固定放大 EHT 的参考相位精度限制；对精确本征态，在放大未达硬件极限时采样复杂度为 \mathcal{O}(\log(1/\epsilon))（忽略双对数因子）；在不完美本征态制备下，通过分离不可约制备误差、统计误差与幅度诱导偏差来系统抑制算法误差，而传统固定放大测试通常存在非零偏差下限；以设备重启次数衡量时，硬件不受限区间的重启复杂度为 \mathcal{O}(1/\epsilon)（忽略对数因子），固定放大为 \mathcal{O}(1/\epsilon^2)，达到硬件极限时恢复二次缩放但仍保留常数因子优势；数值结果支持精确与不完美本征态以及代表性电路噪声下的结论，方法面向近期量子处理器的高精度相位估计，尚未在真实硬件上演示。
innovations: 提出自适应纠缠辅助 Hadamard 测试（AEHT），通过迭代精化参考相位逐步增强 GHZ 态放大，以克服传统固定放大 EHT 的参考相位精度限制。
将 AEHT 扩展到不完美本征态制备场景，以抑制传统 EHT 中由幅度诱导的系统偏差。
引入设备重启次数作为量子相位估计的硬件感知成本度量，并在该度量下用数值实验比较 AEHT 与传统方法。

title: QUFIG: GNN-Based Prediction of Quantum Fault Injection Vulnerabilities with Gate-Level Precision
comment: Accepted by IEEE International Conference on Computer Design (ICCD) 2026
summary: The growing scale and accessibility of quantum hardware exposed new reliability and security challenges in the quantum computing workflow, such as the run-time fault injection attacks in cloud-based quantum computing platforms. However, existing works fail to identify vulnerabilities with gate-level precision or adapt to run-time environments. In this work, we formulate gate-level fault analysis as a learning-guided prioritization problem under restricted fidelity budgets. The framework uses a circuit-DAG-based GNN backbone to predict the vulnerability score of each gate to each type of injected fault, defined as the impact of the gate-fault pair on circuit fidelity. The gate-fault pairs are then ranked by their vulnerability score. Experiments on QASMbench and HamLib MaxCut show that QUFIG recovers high-impact vulnerable gate-fault pairs with fewer inspections than random and depth-based heuristics. Our results show that QUFIG can reduce the number of gates requiring inspection by 2.9--19.8% while maintaining effective fault identification, allowing quantum circuit designers to identify vulnerabilities and apply targeted defenses more efficiently.

AI.abstract_zh: 量子硬件的规模和可访问性不断增长，在量子计算工作流中暴露出新的可靠性与安全挑战，例如基于云的量子计算平台中的运行时故障注入攻击。然而，现有工作无法以门级精度识别脆弱性，也无法适应运行时环境。在本工作中，我们将门级故障分析形式化为受限保真度预算下的学习引导优先级排序问题。该框架使用基于电路 DAG 的 GNN 主干来预测每个门对每一类注入故障的脆弱性分数，该分数定义为门-故障对对电路保真度的影响。随后，门-故障对按其脆弱性分数排序。在 QASMbench 和 HamLib MaxCut 上的实验表明，与随机和基于深度的启发式方法相比，QUFIG 能以更少的检查恢复高影响的脆弱门-故障对。我们的结果表明，QUFIG 可以在保持有效故障识别的同时，将需要检查的门数量减少 2.9--19.8%，从而使量子电路设计者能够更高效地识别脆弱性并施加有针对性的防御。
AI.conclusion: QuFIG 面向量子电路中的预算受限门级脆弱性优先级排序；作者基于 QASMbench 与 HamLib MaxCut 电路构建门级故障注入数据集，覆盖多种门类型、电路深度、依赖结构和 NISQ 故障通道。结果表明，学习得到的脆弱性分数可优先排序高影响门，并减少达到目标恢复水平所需的详细门检查次数；与随机和简单结构遍历策略相比，QuFIG 排序更有效地识别主导电路级保真度损失和应用级性能下降的门。通过在部署前识别主导保真度损失的门，QuFIG 可帮助不可信云量子平台用户将故障模拟、缓解和安全审计集中在最关键的位置。
innovations: 将门级故障分析建模为受限保真度预算下的学习引导优先级排序问题。
使用基于电路 DAG 的 GNN 预测每个门对每类注入故障的脆弱性分数，并按分数对门-故障对排序。
在 QASMbench 与 HamLib MaxCut 上，相比随机和基于深度的启发式方法，在保持有效故障识别的同时减少需检查门数 2.9--19.8%。

title: Non-Markovian effects on informational steady states
summary: Informational steady states (ISSs) arise when the rate at which information is gained from continuous measurements is exactly balanced by the rate at which information from earlier measurements is lost to the environment. While ISSs have been studied in Markovian settings, relatively little is known about how memory effects influence their formation and steady-state properties. In this work, we investigate non-Markovian effects on ISSs within the framework of continuously monitored collision models. We model the environment as a sequence of two-qubit ancillas and find that, for this specific model, the steady-state information gain per measurement is negatively correlated with the degree of non-Markovianity. Numerical results further characterize how the system-ancilla and ancilla-ancilla interaction parameters influence both the degree of non-Markovianity and the steady-state information gain.

AI.abstract_zh: 信息稳态（ISSs）出现在从连续测量中获得信息的速率恰好被先前测量信息流失到环境的速率所平衡时。虽然ISSs已在马尔可夫设定下被研究，但关于记忆效应如何影响其形成和稳态性质所知相对较少。在这项工作中，我们在连续监测碰撞模型框架内研究非马尔可夫效应对ISSs的影响。我们将环境建模为一系列双量子比特辅助比特，并发现对于这一特定模型，每次测量的稳态信息增益与非马尔可夫程度呈负相关。数值结果进一步刻画了系统-辅助比特和辅助比特-辅助比特相互作用参数如何影响非马尔可夫程度和稳态信息增益。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的连续监测碰撞模型中，数值结果表明：马尔可夫情形下稳态信息增益 G∞ 在 θXY1 略小于 π/4、θXY2≈π/4 时达到峰值；要使非马尔可夫度 N_BLP 较大，θY1Y2 与 θY2Y1 都需较大，其中之一较小时会成为瓶颈；当 θY1Y2、θY2Y1 较大时系统反复与同一状态相互作用，稳态关联较弱；高 θXY1=θXY2 时，Y1Y2 相互作用期间 XY1 关联的下降可由 XY2 相互作用期间的增加抵消；高 θYY=θY1Y2=θY2Y1 时，系统等效地与相互作用参数为 θXY1+θXY2 的单量子比特辅助比特相互作用，N_BLP 在 θXY1+θXY2≈π/2 时最大化。该特定模型中观察到 G∞ 与 N_BLP 呈统计显著负相关，但作者强调这不是因果关系，且 N_BLP 基于趋于稳态的过程计算而 G∞ 在稳态计算。上述结论主要基于该模型及数值分析，适用范围有限。
innovations: 在连续监测碰撞模型框架中研究非马尔可夫效应对信息稳态形成及稳态性质的影响。
将环境建模为双量子比特辅助比特序列，并数值刻画系统-辅助比特与辅助比特-辅助比特相互作用参数对非马尔可夫度和稳态信息增益的作用。
在该特定模型中发现每次测量的稳态信息增益与非马尔可夫度呈统计显著负相关，并指出该相关不代表因果。

title: Learnt Attacks on Quantum Key Distribution under Channel Noise and Device Drift
comment: Presented as submission 202 at QCrypt 2026 qcrypt.net/2026/technical/accepted-papers/. A parallel work exploring the machine-learning aspects of this approach, titled "Sparsity for Free: A Budget-Induced Equilibrium in Joint Topology-Parameter Search'', has been accepted for NeurIPS 2026
summary: Quantum key distribution (QKD) links are provisioned from security analyses of stationary channels, whereas the devices that determine the channel drift between recalibrations. Whether an eavesdropper who cannot alter the channel's own noise gains by following that drift has not been quantified. Adaptive eavesdropping is posed here as a constrained Markov decision process in which the attacker selects one circuit per round while the noise level follows an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process and the abort condition is a budget over each block of rounds. The value of adaptation is bounded by the best fixed circuit and a dynamic-programming upper bound. The actions are learnt attacks. Whereas Decker et al. trained a parametrised circuit on a fixed gate template against a fixed channel, here the gate structure and rotation angles are searched jointly. This yields circuits compact enough to form a discrete action set, extending the construction to noise models lacking a known template, including the amplitude damping channel. On device-independent E91 under bilateral depolarising noise, a reinforcement-learning attacker raises her Holevo information from $0.135$ for the best fixed circuit to $0.348$ at zero detection, $98\%$ of the upper bound. On BB84 under a drifting bit-flip channel, she exceeds a conservative noise-indexed rule by $0.024$ in fidelity, reaching $99\%$ of the upper bound. Under stationary noise, the attacker's gain from basis asymmetry changes sign between an averaged and a per-basis error-rate constraint. The search, started from random gate sequences, recovers the analytical cloners and the collective-attack key rate, and meets the lower bound of the Winick--Lütkenhaus--Coles objective from above.
